summary: 5 individual white lights, first two lights one after another, last three lights in a triangle formation
description: First saw one "light" traveling from the Northeast sky to the south. Thought it was a plane. Sixty seconds passed and another light appeared. Seemed to be following first light. Still, could not identify blinking light usually found on plane. All of a sudden, three white lights appeared. They were flying in a triangle formation. I knew this was not a commercial plane nor private pilots. They all disappeared to the south. The next day I was in a town called Fish Creek. I was speaking to my step-son about what we saw and a lady said she saw fireballs in the sky the previous night in Fish Creek. These objects made no noise not any identifying blinking lights as found on planes. They all travelled at a steady pace.

summary: Five red/orange round objects flying one after the other North to South, no sound.
description: Walking North on residential street and low on the horizon saw a red/orange small round object moving South toward me. Very high, made no sound. As it went over my head it faded away or went up into atmosphere and disappeared. Looked North again, here comes another one. Repeated five times with two objects pretty close to each other, one behind the other. Went in to get my husband and of course they stopped. Went out 15 minutes later but didn't see anymore. At first thought it was fireworks but they were moving quickly south in a very straight line. Then I thought about drones...they were coming from the direction of Boeing Field.

summary: fireball appears and disappears in less then twenty seconds.
description: On back porch, fireball looking object came up from distant tree lines, continued to travel up. It then stopped for about 10 seconds, each second getting smaller and smaller until it completely disappeared.

summary: 5 orange cirgular lights in line, no noise, varied speed, all turned at same point in order, went white & vanished about 25 minut sight
description: Last night (7/5/2012) while playing cards in the Gazebo with my daughter and grand children about 22:00, I spotted three followed by two more bright orange lights coming at us from Lake Ontario. My 1st impressions were of helicopters on maneuvers from Fort Drum. Coming on a straight course as if they had left the nuclear power plant at Oswego & were heading for our house. (We are about 3 miles inland of the East Shore of Lake Ontario, Between Pulaski and Sandy Creek, NY) They were in a straight line and we went out to see and hear better. (I grabbed my camera too.) There was never any sound. Almost directly overhead they made a sharp right turn and headed South one at a time. Just as they turned each in less than a minute became a dim white line and immediately disappeared. This process took about 20-25 minutes total from sighting to disappearing. Does anyone have any Idea what they were? Pictures did not take in this box.. (all sitings perfect circles only one picture was circular) As we watched they all looked like perfect spheres until turning. I cannot explain those pictures that are not. The pictures are in order of when taken. Those you may think were the camera moving, show…

summary: UFO sighting over a carnival in Southern York County, Pennsylvania, caught on camera.
description:
My friend and I were walking around the local carnival when we spotted 2 large, dark red-orange lights flying South only a few miles away. We walked to the edge of the carnival so I could try recording them on my phone away from the bright lights of the rides and games, but the red lights flew upwards and faded away. 
Seconds later, a third dark red-orange light appeared in the near Southwest, nowhere near a horizon, maybe 1 or 2 miles away. It flew Northeast, but when it reached a certain point, it turned and began to fly South, exactly in the same path as the first two lights. 
At that moment, a very bright fourth red-orange light materialized less than a mile away, again nowhere near the horizon. It flew Northeast, and when it reached the same point as the others, began to fly almost directly South. After about one minute, it just disappeared completely. 
The last two lights were recorded on video.

summary: Observed and photographed five silent stationary discs. Two with red lights underneath and three with white lights.
description:
While driving we observed five disc shaped objects standing stationary in the sky. Initially we thought we were looking at helicopters hovering. 
We drove directly under them, shut the car off and got out. There was no sound, and when looking up saw what appeared to look like large red LED lights in a circular pattern with one large one in the middle on the bottom of two of the craft the other craft were white. 
We watched them for about two minutes outside the car and took two photos and one short movie with an iPhone. 
The five craft then proceeded east bound toward Lake Michigan. 
One observer is a police officer and lawyer. The other observer is a disabled steelworker.

summary: 3 amber glowing lights crossed the sky silently around 9:25pm. Have video and pics.
Orange and yellow fireball, seen by 3 in burien, WA.
description: At around 7:30 at night on July 5th 2012, My girlfriend, her mother and I were outside, and I noticed a orange ball with a yellow ball inside of it floating in the air. For about 2 minutes the object stayed completely still, aside from a "wobbling" effect the orange and yellow object had. It looked like a ball of fire with another ball of fire inside of it. A fter 2 minutes, the object ascended into the sky with a "bending" motion as if it were flung into space, and within about a second it looked like a satellite and then completely disappeared out of sight. For comparison's sake it looked just like "team rocket blasting off again" from the pokemon cartoons.

summary: Bright Flourescent lights with orange flame doing figure 8's not making any sound and dissappearing.
description: My kids were playing out in the pool when my one son came into the house telling me that there were lights outside. I went out and saw two like 8 ft. flourescent lights 5 x brighter than normal, with a bright orange flame on top. I saw it at a 45 degree angle about 150 ft. up doing figure 8's. Then it moved to the right 50 ft. then like a stone's throw fast it went southwest and dissappeared. It never made any sound.

summary: 4 lights/orbs rotating
description:
There were 4 identical lights/orbs. The lights all rotated clockwise in a circle around an arbitrary point. After one and a half rotations, the four lights stopped momentarily and converged to a central point. At the central point, the four lights again paused for a moment, then returned to their positions and proceeded to rotate, again, counterclockwise.
We suspect advertising lights. PD

summary: I was in my room and my dad was in his room when he noticed an object in the sky through his window and went to the front yard where my brother, sister, and mom were.  My brother ran to my room to…
Morphing UFO cigar shaped in melbourne australia
description:
On the 5th of july in south east melbourne australia, a friend and i noticed Three bright multicolored lights in the sky moving in a fast formation. I went to grab my i phone to take pictures when i noticed these lights had stopped and had infact gone brighter green, red, white and electric blue where these colors. When returning from getting my i phone we noticed a large cigar shaped object had formed in the sky replacing one of the white lights.
After taking various photos we herd a strange high pitched noise and noticed the objects where moving again in formation. The cigar shaped object appered to have somehow formed three seperate lights and went smaller in size while changing color to pink. At this time we had noticed an airplane in mid air in the other direction.
We found it quite difficult to take photos, up load them, and to concentrate...
These objects seemed to VANISH in a blink of an eye, one by one.
On this morning the moon was still up and almost full as it was lighting up the sky all night. When the objects vanished a thick fog formed as i was driving home. however i was able to notice a large Golden light in the middle of a field glowing and fading away. I was…

summary: Orange glowing Orb in El Dorado,Kansas
description:
Hi, this is the first time I have ever reported a UFO, but I had to share it.
I live in El dorado, Ks.. I work in Wichita, Ks and I was on my way to work this morning 7-5-12 at 4:30 AM. I was at the intersection on Haver hill and Central this morning in El dorado at 4:30 AM with my turn signal on, waiting to turn West on 254 on my way to work in Wichita. As I was sitting there an Orange ORB appeared about a 45 degree angle out in front of me in the sky. It appeared to be less than a mile in the air. This was an orange orb which appeared to have an odd looking aurora or energy field surrounding the orb. There also appeared to be some kind of structure in the orb but I could not make it out. The orb was glowing and appeared to be pulsating and was very bright. As I sat at the turn light the orb was moving to the North East very slow, I decided to follow it. I followed the orb about 1 mile as it seem to be just glowing and appeared to be moving slowly. As I followed the orb, the orb appeared to slow down and I pulled over. I turned off my car and noticed! there was no sound at all in the air, also there was no blinking light what so ever on the orb.
 I started to flicker my…

summary: Moving "stars" and shifting shapes at Wrightsville Beach.
description:
I've sifted through the archives in this site and have found that although there have been reports seemingly describing what I and a few others have seen down at Wrightsville Beach, none of them offer contact information and so they're, regrettably, somewhat more prone to be dismissed. However, I'm too moved to want to show people what's been going on down there to just let that slip on by, so I'll add a few of my tales as well, beginning with last night's most recent event.
Now, since my first encounter at Wrightsville Beach (will describe later), I have come back a few times with a few different groups of people to show them what I refer to as the "Dancing Star." It's a large, yellowish light (sometimes seemingly blinking different colors) that will distinguish itself from its counterparts by moving in swirling, zig-zagging patterns back and fourth, though it still mostly remains true to its general area or "zone." Upon several inspections of the thing, I realized that right before it moves, you can faintly catch a tiny pinprick of light near it flash before the main star moves towards it. I called the motion "kiting," since it seemed that the small pinpricks would determine…

summary: I keep a vigilant watch, I had an out of body experience in 1979 and I was aboard a space craft and greeted and spoken two by two humans, I then returned to my body shortly after. In 2005 in Tacoma,…
description: I grew up on the top of a hill; all I do is monitor the skies. I am curious about the two bright Orange lights flying in tandem one at a higher altitude then the other. I watched them as I always watch air craft my whole life. Orange, I have never seen orange, and then they disappeared in front of me, in clear skies. I do not believe that they turned, they just disappeared. Question is were they drones.? I also witnessed a large meteorite cross the sky in front of me in Utah in 1984. I have also seen a translucent light move across the night sky that was weird. I am interested in the orange lights if anyone can explain them. Thanks

summary: Orange/red, low flying spherical craft seen 200 yards away from 10th ave S. and Castle Way.
description:
12:00AM-While entering my subdivision I observed in the sky a low flying spherical fireball looking craft(roughly the size of a one man helicopter) no more than 200 yards away moving south toward a nearby lake. My friend turned the vehicle around and it back on the main road. I quickly exited the vehicle to get a better look and the craft performed a strange maneuver as it rapidly reversed directions (without turning around) then shot straight up and continued south toward Lake Lowell where I lost sight of it after about 30 seconds.
Observer 1: Student at University of Idaho Observer 2: Employee at Jackson Oil Headquarters

summary: I saw two green orbs floating next to each other, metal prongs jut out from these orbs and these orbs spin and jut into the sky.
description: On July 5th, 2012 at 12:55AM I was driving by myself West (towards town) on a county road in Tallahassee, FL and had just driven down a large hill and was approaching a second smaller hill. About 300 feet in front of me I saw two hazy mint green orbs floating, about eight feet above the ground. They were each a little larger than a grapefruit (possibly bigger), almost sparkled (maybe that signifies lights) and had about three feet of space between them. The three feet of space acted as an imaginary horizontal line across the middle of the road even though the orbs seemed to be independent of each other. In an instant, metal prongs, thin in nature and almost rectangular shaped, jutted out around the diameter (middle) of each orb (left/right, not up/down). Then, each orb spun (left/right) independently in their places and shot up into the sky, leaving an almost glow where they had just been hovering. This happened so quickly that they were out of sight completely by the time I drove through the place where they had been. From the time I saw them to the time they shot into the sky, it was only a five second time span. It all felt very advanced, direct and incredibly fast.

summary: Orange fireball slowly floats across the night sky.
description:
Wednesday night/ Thursday morning I was leaving for work and noticed an orange glowing ball float across the sky. No noise was heard. It was heading toward the northeast on a straight path until it was no longer visible behind the treeline.
Fireworks were being set off at the time, however, I can say with near 100% certainty that this was not a firework.
 The object had the appearance of a translucent bag with moving flames inside. Size/distance are hard to judge, but I would guess at least 2000 feet up and over 10 feet in diameter.

summary: 3 reddish colored objects traveling under 100 kts zoomed out of sight without any sound
description:
3 red lights traveling under 100 knots heading north parallel to the beach turned 90 degrees heading east at the pier south of the dunlawton ramp and then zoomed out of sight. No noise, no strobes, no nav lights, just a solid redish glow. 
I looked at them thru 10x binoculars and could not make out any distinct shapes?

summary: Two lights/objects over DC with quick, erratic movements
description: Approximately an hour after the fireworks in DC had ended, we observed a high altitude object with erratic movements. Far too erratic to be an airplane, and moving too quickly to be a weather ballon. The object stayed in the same general area and moved back-and forth several times for a few minutes. A second object similar object appeared close-by after a few minutes with the same erratic movements. Did anyone else see these strange lights over DC?

summary: Object flying then disappears
description: I was outside and seen something glowing in the sky looked like fire but then I noticed it started to move... It started flying towards us. I started to record it on my cell phone. I'm watching this start to fly away and record it at the same time when I notice the light disappears on my phone? But I can see it right In front of me, I look down to fix my phone and look back up and it's gone.... I rewatched the video and I seen the "light" UFO whatever it was do like a circle motion and then disappears ...

summary: Two red lights seen moving near each other until disappearing.
description: While watching fireworks I noticed two red lights that were stationary. I asked if my friend could see them too, they confirmed. I continued to watch for 30 seconds or so after noticing them to see if they were just lights or something else. They both moved slowly, one moving upward the other down, confirming they were not just lights. They came to a full stop then started to fade away. I'm not sure if they were moving away or just faded out of the visible light spectrum. The whole thing lasted roughly 2 minutes.

summary: 5 orange lights moving strangely
description:
We were watching the fireworks from our patio when we noticed a bright orange light ... And we thought that was wierd, but then we saw 2 more appear... And then another...(I have this on video on my phone) And then one light just zipped away from the others and , well, it was wierd....I was so scared!!! My husband said, "Hey, Come here," or something like that... 
I FREAKED!!! You have GOT to see this video... I am NOT a nut job....
Thank you for your time...

summary: 5 red/orange lights moving fast from the NE to the SW over Everett.
description:
My wife and I were on a walk after watching fireworks and we saw 5 fireballs traveling from NE to SW. They had a red/orange light that flickered but we couldn't see any smoke or hear the objects. They were moving very fast and eventually disappeared out of sight to the SE. 
We couldn't find anything online about it. If anyone has any insight please share. They seemed to be traveling like missiles and we speculated that something could have been fired from a ship near the Naval base in Everett. But, obviously that is purely speculation. 
Thanks.

summary: There was a reflection on the window of a circular disk that seemed to be going in a circular motion it seemed like the reflection of the moon but it was behind the building so it couldnt have been…
description: Source of the report provides no contact information. PD

summary: Bright Orange light seen in Orlando sky.
description:
Approx 11:30 pm I saw a bright flickering orange light ascending into the sky, I am aware it is Independence day but this was no firework. It seemed large and bright orange and shrank as it ascended, distance unknown. 
I watched until I could not see any longer. My first guess was a rocket launch, but it was not in the direction of the Kennedy space center, it was from more central inland. 
I still think it was a rocket launch to space, but could not locate any information on the internet.

summary: Square dark object w/red lights at each of its corners over Casco Bay Bridge in Portland, ME
description:
My cousin and I (who are in our early 20's) were driving back home to South Portland over the Casco Bay Bridge when I noticed an object in the air (a little bit lower than where most planes fly). It wasn't moving, just staying in the air. I pointed it out to my cousin, and she said it must be a plane. Then it started moving, faster than a plane would. We could clearly see the shape. It was square, with 4 red lights at each corner of the craft. It seemed to be dark gray or black. Before my cousin had the chance to catch it on film, it was already over Casco Bay and into the Portland area. Although there may not be any connection, two police cars had their sirens on and started going across the bridge just as it moved into Portland.
It looked exactly like the ones in these pictures: 
http://www.ufopictures.info/triangular/

summary: Red-Orange ovals flying across hwy 280
description:
I was outside smoking a cigarette and saw a orange-red light, moving silently and slowly from my right to left at about a 30 degree angle from my viewpoint. 
A second, then third object came into view, so I ran up onto my porch and called my mom and dad to come out. As they did a fourth flew by. It was the first one they saw, then 3 more also flew by. 
The first few objects flew in a straight line, but the last 3 were varying their direction slightly. 
One moved up and down a little, the other 2 flew in an arc away from the direction of the preceding 5 objects due east.

summary: Four red/orange orbs traveling horizontally in a perfect line, in perfect distance from each other
description:
I saw 4 orange/red fireballs traveling horizontally across the Western sky from the North to the South.
I ran to get my binoculars, because they were traveling silently, in a perfect line, keeping perfect distance with each other, and traveling at the exact same speed. They looked so bright, and had a bit of a disc shape surrounding the bright orange/red center.
With my binaculars, they looked like comets, with space dust or something burning around them, and a bit of a short "tail."
I watched them for a couple minutes, then realized I should document them, and ran to get my video camera.
In a panic to capture the 4th one that was passing by, almost out of sight, (too many trees here in Washington state), I took a very distorted video. My video looks like a blob, and not what I witnessed of the perfect formation, speed and travel of the objects through my binnaculars.

summary: 3 Large Fireballs rose from ground in succession and followed each other West to East across sky into Heat Lightening near Reading, PA
description:
Went outside to light sparklers. Saw some fireworks coming from the trees East of us. Were waiting to take picture of them when 3 VERY Large, Bright Fireballs came up from the direction of the ground one after the other. 
At first, we thought it was some strange firework but they remained intact. They were spaced a few seconds apart, rose from ground one after the other & flew following each other in a straight line across the sky. They flew West to East over Exeter/Reading,PA toward what looked like Heat Lightening in the distance. Lasted about 5 minutes. Took some pictures.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides little contact information. PD

summary: one light catching up with another then shooting up and flying away
description: my wife was driving east bound on 103 towards 75 from bluffton at the time i was at my house. we both was at different places but both saw a bright light slowly traveling above the horizon on the east side of bluffton. then we noticed another traveling much faster and a couple hundred feet above traveling much faster to catch up then it shot up couple hundred feet more then started to get really small as i believe it flew out of our atmosphere.

summary: Fireball seen in Xenia Ohio
description:
My husband and I had just returned from watching a fireworks display in Kettering Ohio. I took my dog out to the back yard to relieve himself.
I heard and saw my neighbors behind my house looking toward the south east fire off fireworks. The rocket went off in the air, and as I looked I noticed a strange object just apparently hovering. It moved slowly and silently from side to side very slowly, then hovered. It was rather large and looked like a fireball. It was red with some mixed colors in it. 
I tried to call my husband out to see it, but he didn't hear me. My daughter came out with me though and she saw it too as it slowly moved away from us to the south east. It continued on until it disappeared from view. 
It was very controlled, moved slowly and made no sound at all. once it began to move away it seemed to disappear rather quickly.

summary: Fireball seen in Xenia Ohio July 4, 2012
description:
My husband and I had just returned from watching a fireworks display in Kettering Ohio. I took my dog out to the back yard.
I heard and saw my neighbors behind my house looking towards the south east firing off fireworks. The rocket went off in the air, and as I looked I noticed a strange object just apparently hovering. 
It moved slowly and silently from side to side. It was rather large and looked like a fireball. It was red with some mixed colors in it of red, yellow and orange. The colors seemed to be fluctuating.
I tried to call my husband out to see it, but he didn't hear me. My daughter came out with me and she saw it too as it slowly moved away from us to the south east. 
It continued on until it disappeared from view. It was very controlled, moved slowly and made no sound at all. Once it began to move away and seemed to disappear rather quickly. The object was at just above the houses on the horizon. There was little or no wind at the time.

summary: Fireball over St. Louis, MO July 4th
description:
On the 4th of July 2012, 4 adults and 2 teenage children were sitting on our back porch talking at 11:05 pm after the holiday celebration, when I noticed a fireball type craft flying in the sky horizontally from southeast to northwest, from Ferguson, MO to St. Charles, MO or Alton, IL area. Once I pointed it out to the others they all saw it too. It flew slowly and the path it flew was straight, but did vary every so often and go up or down slightly, it flew over us and continued on until it was out of our sight, descending slightly the further it went.
The size of the fireball type craft was approximately 1/8 to ¼ the size of the moon as we see it on earth. The craft seemed rather jagged like it was on fire. It didn’t appear to have a shape other than a jagged ball. It was not close to us but was easily visible. The craft made no noise, as the planes etc. we see often in our area do. It was very deep reddish orange.
This is the second craft I have seen in this general area. July 4th 1997 I saw a very large craft over Hwy 370 near St. Charles MO, as did thousands of other fireworks watchers.

summary: Five observers at 23:15 noticed a large UFO traveling slowly west to east with very bright flashing red and white lights.
description:
Viewing through binoculars, object appeared to be on fire. 
Observed for 1 min before it vanished.
Report is not inconsistent with the sighting of a commercial aircraft, we believe. PD

summary: The two orange silent  fireballs or spheres just kept coming closer, moving from west to the south.
description:
July 4, 2012 We were waiting to see fireworks on Fox Island. Someone said that those in the sky will really be a big display when they go off; however, the orange fireballs or spheres just kept coming closer , moving from the west to the south. One was further ahead of the other and I watched them while they were rising upwards and then out of sight. 
An air traffic controller was the first to spot them and said he didn't have a clue of what they were.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: 3 bright orange objects moving across the sky in a straight line.
description: Saw a bright round orange light in the sky driving home (similar to large glowing embers but in formation). Got home and got out and saw two large orange objects moving south in a line, one passed the other at high rate of speed and then a third one came a 1 min or so behind. They all seemed to dim and brighten as they disappeared from sight.

summary: amber colored object,shaped like a kitchen match,still, no movement,faded away.
description:
I am a graphic designer & sign painter, I am very aware of my surroundings, it's my job. 
Driving home late on the 4th after 11pm in a rural area, mountains all over, I saw an amber colored object sitting still in the western sky.
I pulled over. The object was shaped like a kitchen match. It was horizontal & very still. I could not believe what I was seeing! No noise, no movement, just there. Watched it for 5 minutes, & then it slowly faded out of sight like a dimmer switch was used. I had a cell phone, but I never got it out to take a picture. It just never crossed my mind.

summary: On July 4 at approx eleven pm I was standing in my back yard when from my right an orange orb or light appeared traveling at a slow speed.  It was relatively high in the sky but appeared to be very…
description:
I was thinking someone else must be able to see these objects, people were out shooting off fireworks and so the chance that someone was looking up at the sky were pretty good --I felt very excited seeing these objects because I've never seen anything like them before and I felt I was seeing a rare sight but by no means did I think I was the only one who could see them. The big dipper was in the north/northwest sky and was setting..these objects were approximately half-way up the dipper or about half way up the sky in my estimation, about the same height a small aircraft would fly and lower than a jet. I have seen loads of aircraft in the skies from my backyard and none have ever had lights as large as these two were, not even a helicopter close in the sky would have that type of light.
The two lights, the second light having moved closer to the first light, continued to move steadily and at the same height in a southerly direction and I watched them looking from one to the other when I noticed the first light I had seen appeared to turn to the west and began to get smaller as if fading out or even burning out? I watched it completely disappear in less than a minute. I looked back…

summary: My family and neighbors were watching an orange light fly across the sky every time a firework would explode.  This light would move from one area of sky to another in split seconds.  We all watched…
description:
Family and friends were getting nervous and packed their chairs to go inside. I remained outside, captivated by the experience and my own curiosity. I remember feeling the desire to fly as fast as that light had zipped across the sky. I turned to go inside when I felt my hair stand on end. I looked up and the a dark black oval shaped craft was floating stationary just above the top of the trees and house.
The craft slowly started to move to the west. I appeared to be alone and the craft too dark to see on my phones camera. I ran to the back yard and jumped onto the cement wall at the back of the property seperating the yard from the city's cemetary. The craft still overhead and slowly moving.
The craft appeared to be approx distance from the house to cement wall, the distance of two planted trees from end to end or approx 15ft. It moved into the light shining on the American flag and again, remained stationary approximate height of the flag pole on an axis with the front end slightly higher than the back. The craft moved so slowly at this point, adjusting the nose a little higher and pointing to the south eastern sky. Its color was profoundly dark black. No windows. smooth…

summary: Orange glowing orbs over Seattle July 4th 2012
description: Time: Roughly 11PM PST for the first sighting. 11:20PM PST for second sighting: There were large crowds gathered in the area for the 4th of July fireworks show at Lake Union downtown Seattle. The first time we saw it was about 10 minutes after the fireworks display had ended. There were still people launching fireworks from houses nearby but this was not any kind of firework. We were outside on a friends deck when I noticed a glowing flickering orb parallel to our position at a 45 degree angle. The object appeared to be about a 1/2 mile away at the time moving maybe 5-10mph and appeared to hover at altitude twice as it moved south. I pointed it out to several friends and they all witnessed it too. The object as best as I can describe was round, glowing and flickering almost fire like and as far as we could tell silent. At its closest point to us there was a second smaller object very dim following slightly behind it and off to one side. It was hard to judge ! the distance of the second object to the first although it did cross it's path more than once. This area of downtown Seattle is in the flight path for the airport so there are planes in the sky constantly. Along the flight…

summary: one bright orange ball traveling east into the sky, then black shadowey object descending.
description:
what the hell did i just see? That's all i could say last night, july 4 2012, I KNOW it wasn't fireworks, They don't fly like that........... On our way home from having dinner at Dennys, about 11:00 pm, I saw a bright orange red light in the sky and i said to my boyfriend what is that bright light, I thought it was a light from an airplane coming in for a landing in Stuart. I live off green river drive, we see a lot of planes coming in from the east. we stopped in the middle of the road and watched it, and first it wasn't moving then it started heading up slowly and started to disappear east into the sky the lights flickered and dimmed and then it was gone....... So I thought, i said did you see that to my boyfriend and i said it just disappeared and he just looking in the sky and said no it didn't it came back down and is behind us, I said what?, he said its right there and i looked and i couldn't see it, i said where and he said its a shadow, there's no li! ghts and i looked and ....damn just a black shape in the air just above the trees and coming down in steps. and it disappeared. 
WHAT THE HELL DID I JUST SEE?.......................................................?

summary: Awestruct at the numerous air traffic on the 4th of July.
description:
Some of them would start out with white lights and then turn to a red color, some were already red and then they would appear to disappear. There were too many to count. 
After about 50, my husband said that they maybe jetfighters heading back from Chicago to Griffith after an airshow. This started at 11pm and I went in around 2am and they were still continuing to fly over. They have no sound. 
Very curious to find out if this was a hoax or just some sort of military exercise.

summary: 7 bright objects flying by
description: I was sitting on my front porch, watching fireworks, when I noticed 2 bright red objects flying by, then 3 more, then 2 more. They were moving in a stright line, going west to east. We do have an air force base in the direction they were moving. I did not hear any sounds with them. They were not fireworks, that much I am sure of, they were moving like plains across the sky. Each one of them was bright red which made me stop and wonder what I was seeing, with no sound of an aircraft. They didn't flash , just bright red objects flying by.

summary: Heard a vibrating sound and looked out the 3rd floor window.  Saw a rotating star tetrahedron. It lit up the sky like it was day.  Moved slowly, we ran outside in excitement but it had started moving…

There aren't any fireworks that I know of able to showcase that kind of control. 
We stared at it, then looked at each other and both said "Holy s%$*, a UFO." Across the street (about 50 feet away) we heard another person say the same thing, so we weren't the only ones. We were sitting on Indian Trail facing north, directly across from IMSA. 
Please, I would like to know if any one else reported this so I know I'm not crazy. The time I put down is approximate. I don't really remember looking at my phone for the time. It didn't even occur to me to at least attempt to take a picture, even though it wouldn't really show anything definitive.

summary: 2 Red Balls Flying North from South. Objects Flying Parallel 1000 feet apart at kite level. Silent.  Disappeared
description:
July 4, 2012 - Moore, Oklahoma: Watching Fireworks in backyard with mother. I noticed a Red Light traveling directly towards us. I first thought it was a low flying plane or helicopter. After a few seconds I told my mother that "something is not normal." 
I stood and walked to a very low fence to observe and noticed the second red light travelling parallel to the other about 1000 feet apart. Both were silent and were traveling at a very high speed South from the Norman, Oklahoma, area directly North to Moore, Oklahoma. The red ball flying on the East disappeared less than a quarter mile from my location. The red ball on the West side flew directly over the house and continued for several mile North and disappeared as well. I had my phone in hand, but was so intrigued that I never thought to capture on film or photo. As it was the 4th of July, it seems there had to by many other witnesses to this sighting.

summary: Red glowing ball of  light seen over Warren Michigan

My van was facing west and we had a clear view of the fireworks which rose above the houses in front of us. The sky was clear and there was no wind at the time. My wife noticed a red glowing ball of light which was at about a 60 degree angle from us and appeared to be as high as the highest point of the exploding fireworks. At first we both thought it was debris still burning from a firework but it continued to glow. It seemed to smoothly and slowly gain height, traveling in a straight line from the northwest to southeast. I had rolled down the driver's side window to take a better look. I did not see a flashing beacon or any other colors of light which are typically seen on aircraft. The ball of light did not blink and remained a solid red color. It appeared to be slightly larger than the size of a star. It made! no sound and continued heading southeast until it just seemed to vanish.

At first I figured they were the remnants of some fireworks, possibly burning embers, but they didn't move, they stayed stationary until they eventually faded. 
Meanwhile, another brighter one was moving from the West toward the same location in the sky, slowly. We thought at first, could these be airplanes? No, there was an airplane moving farther toward the west, and they looked nothing alike. The color of the moving object was yellow/orange like the others and also flickering, like fire. Being the night of the 4th, logic would say these were some remnants of fireworks, but they sure didn't look or behave like any fireworks I've ever seen. It was a full moon too, but the moon was of course to the South! East, and was visible. They weren't the moon, or stars either. Meanwhile, around that same time, a friend in nearby Davenport, WA saw something too but I haven't talked to him yet to get the details.

summary: Four lights on the Fourth
description:
We were in the parking lot at 24th Ave. & Nob Hill Blvd. to watch the fireworks show from the fairgrounds. The fireworks show was almost at its end. Then, something caught my eye near the full moon. The moon was about 30 degrees up from the horizon and mostly to the south of us. There were four orange spheres moving away from the sight of the moon. These four lights were in a straight line and appeared to be moving towards us.
The line that they were traveling looked like they were coming up from the SE direction. This is a used flight pattern from Pendleton, OR to Seattle, WA.
These lights were moving slowly along the sight of the full moon. One person, who was also distracted from the fireworks show, asked us what those light were. It was at that time that the lights began to fade out. One by one, the light slowly faded as they past over the line sight of the moon. We wait for some time later to see if they were just high flying planes. If they were, they would have flew over a short time later. We waiting for about another 20 minutes. There was no sign of anything in the night sky. Where did they go? Another cool mystery.

summary: 2 lights at 5 minute intervals flying across the sky,then disapear in the middle of the sky.
description:
We were watching the fireworks when I noticed a orange cirlcular shape fly across the horizon. I thought it was a firework but it kept flying along the horizon for about 1 minute and then it disappeared. 
I grabbed my wife when I saw the same shape and color came back but on a different path from the first. It was in the sky for about another minute before disappearing. 
The night was very clear, I could see stars clearly and there was not enough smoke to have visual interuption. It was not traveling at a hight rate of speed, but the light was very visible and then it disappeared. It did not disappear over the horizon, but in the middle of the sky

summary: Glowing orange ball traveled across the sky in Fern Creek area
description:
My family and I gathered on the deck behind our house in the Fern Creek area of Louisville, Kentucky around 10 pm eastern time to watch the neighborhood fireworks being lit on 4th of July. I, my wife, and 2 teen aged daughters were present.
At 10:11 pm, a glowing orange object appeared in the northeastern sky. The object was traveling very quickly in a southeast direction, and it disappeared in the southern sky about 30 seconds later. The object was flying at an altitude lower than airplanes in the area travel. The object did not make any sound. It was evident from both the altitude of the object, the distance it traveled, its size, and the fact that it made no sound that it was not fireworks. The fireworks being lit in the neighborhood were of the consumer variety, not the kind used by professional fireworks show producers.
One witness, my 19 year old daughter, described the object at "a round orange ball." She also described it as looking like "a crown." 
My wife described it as "glowing," and appearing to look like "a hot air balloon."
My 14 year old daughter described it as "red, glowing, pentagon of fire."
Due to the area’s proximity to the Louisville International Airport…

summary: Bright circle with flame-like orange border in the southeast skies of Michigan.
description: Bright circle with orange flame-like border at first thought to be a firecracker that was going to ignite. It didn't. It travelled from West to East and then disapeared into the sky.

summary: Two more fireball orbs seen tonight, just like my report from last night.
description:
One fireball like orb, brighter than the ones we saw last night, moving quite fast through the sky, came to a slow hover over town and then turned around and headed up and away and disappeared within 5 seconds.
About 5 minutes later a second, dimmer fireball orb was seen coming from the opposite direction. I tried to get a video of it on my droid phone then my phone shut off and i couldnt get it to turn back on before the orb disappeared behind some trees.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Two lights in the sky, looked like fast irratic moving stars
description: My fiance and I were outside laying on our children's trampoline watching the stars an occasionally a firework when two star like objects began mingling in the sky. They went closer almost as one and then split apart and went separate ways. They were very high in the atmosphere and we knew so when we seen a shooting star below where they were flying. We followed the lights one disappeared suddenly and we watched the other keep going until it was no longer visible (20 seconds) There was no sound. We live close enough to see planes fly out of nearby airports and never have they flown in that area at night or have we ever see a plane cross paths with another.

summary: Bright, flashing green object moving quickly across the sky
description:
On July 4th, a group of us were out on a boat on Lake Ontario watching fireworks along the shore. Suddenly, we all noticed a green flashing circle. It seemed to hover for a moment, and then began moving quickly. None of us are sure if it appeared or we just did not notice it coming.
It had a very bright green glow and seemed to flicker. It was above 70 degrees above us and was the size of about 10 stars. We were facing south when we saw it, and it traveled east. To make sure it was not just a stray firework, we watched it travel and saw it go extremely far off into the distance.

summary: We saw ten small lights that ended up forming a triangle that stayed in the sky for ten minutes than just left.
description: During the fourth of july my family saw ten small lights in the sky line up, some of the lights suddenly left, and the rest formed a triangle. We have it on cell phone and we live near Fort Lewis MCcord and know what military aircraft look and sound like. This was weird and nobody has seen anything like what we saw.

summary: Red Orb in Broken Arrow, OK Flew Over
description: A red orb glowing shape that had a radiant glow. It had a tail and a semi hollow center. it rose into about mid sky and flew or floated straight north. It had a heat that you could almost feel. And you could tell it was radiant heat because it was on fire, but not burning.

summary: 20+ huge red fireballs flying south to north near SandSprings,Oklahoma
description: We were all sitting outside watching fireworks and out of nowhere a huge bright red light not flashing was moving south to north wasn't sure what to think of it until a series of other bright red light were following it, I stopped count after 24 not sure if they kept circling and coming back around or if there was actually more than what I saw but they kept coming over the same area. A few were bobbing left to right and I personally have never seen or know of any aircraft that can move side to side as fast as these objects appeared to be performing. Tonight I know from what I and 3 others had witnessed was something strange in the Oklahoma skies.

summary: 2 amber colored lights flying in the same flight path and then darting off and vanishing.
description:
On the 4th of July, 2012, I was having a get together at my house. We were all outback carrying on when i went to walk over to the side of my yard with 2 of my friends to talk because it was getting kind of loud. 
I was looking to the West when i noticed an orange/amber colored sphere pretty high up in the air moving towards us in the sky. I myself am an amateur astronomer and my friends both have credible backgrounds. 1 military and 1 works at an international airport as a plane mechanic. So all and all we are all pretty familiar with what can be seen in the sky collectively. 
I also usually do a fireworks display every year. We all confirmed at the altitude, lack of sound (0 sound being emitted from the object) and speed that this object was nothing that we had ever seen. We watched the object from from west to east then turn towards the city of Philadelphia. 
As it passed over us, it went from its almost floating speed to a fast dart at which point it vanished out of view in a matter of seconds. 
Before we could even comment on what we just saw another object same size, altitude, speed, and flight path as the previous one. We instantly were in awe and had no idea what we just…

summary: Two adults went out on the deck to view neighborhood fireworks.  Fireworks were being set off to the north and to the south of the deck. West view was  a clear sky view.  Winds were ESE at 21 mph.…
description:
We had binoculars and a phone camera. It was too dark, even with low light settings to get any pictures. Through the binoculars, there was a round, glowing shape. They seemed to be more red in color the further away they were and more orange/amber as they got closer.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Three dim lights traveling through the sky.
description: We looked through a scope and could not see an air craft.

summary: Three reddish-orange, pulsating orbs in the sky slowly approached a crowd of people in uneven tandem formation.
description:
My wife and mother-in-law were sitting with me in a large crowd prior to watching the City of Mount Vernon’s 4th of July fireworks display about 10:00 pm at Edgewater Park in West Mount Vernon, when I noticed a fairly large, pulsating-reddish-orange orb slowly approaching from the northeast. I assumed it was just an airplane or helicopter, so I went back to watching the citizens of the area light off their personal fireworks prior to the main event and lost track of the object.
A few minutes later, the three of us together noticed three more orbs, like the first one I had seen, in an uneven tandem formation approaching the area very slowly from the south. I thought they might be helicopters because of the formation’s very slow speed, and so I continued to chat with my wife and mother-in-law while we watched the orbs. After the formation slowed almost to a hover about a mile away, the lead object slowly turned right to the east while the other two remained approximately in place. As the lead object slowly proceeded on its new trajectory, it gradually transitioned from a pulsating reddish-orange color to a smaller solid-whitish light until it seemed to disappear. My wife said…

summary: Today on the 4th of July, my family and I spotted 4 floating lights.  They bobbed in and out of vision but made no noises.  There were also multiple colors.
description: We assume that the sighting was made at night. We have changed the time above, to reflect that fact. PD

summary: very strange red fireballs
description: I was watching fireworks with my husband when we saw 5 or 6 round red fireballs moving across the sky

summary: Light-colored disc-shaped object enveleloped by reddish glow hovers slowly over houses then disappears
description:
I walked out of the front door of a relatives house to get into my car to drive home. It was appx. 9:40 PM. I was alone. Something red in the sky caught my eye. I stopped walking toward my vehicle and looked up. I watched for a few seconds not really able to process what I was seeing. I saw a light colored, thin disc/circle shaped object flying above my head at a fairly slow pace. I vivedly remember searching for wings or the parts of a helicopter; something that would indicate to me it was an identifiable aircraft. There were none. I noted there was no sound. There was a reddish glow around the disc. It did not blink. About 4 seconds into watching, I realized what I was seeing. I ran back into the house and yelled for my relative who came out just in time to see the it as it dipped below pine trees and disappeared.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: See above.  It was really weird.
description: It was hovering. I saw it upon driving. it was round with a white ring and red in the middle. It never moved. It hovered. Then, when I brought my step father out side, he saw it too, it started to move, then it disappeared.

summary: five fireball like objects in the sky as if they were scouting the surrounding area, one was higher than the airplane that flew by. lot of stop and go maneuvering.  Then shot across the sky faster…
BEAMS RED THEN FADES TO ORANGE
description: MY BEST FRIEND CALLED ME AND SAID THAT SHE AND 2 OTHER WITNESSES JUST SAW 3 UFOS. SO NATURALLY MY BOYFRIEND AND I RAN OUTSIDE. AFTER ABOUT 2 MINUTES WE SAW A UFO HEADING NORTH BEAMING RED AND FADING INTO ORANGE. IT KEPT DOING THAT. IT WAS HEADING NORTH FOR ABOUT 5 MINUTES AND FINALLY STARTED TO HEAD EAST FOR 3 MINUTES AND THEN WE COULDN’T SEE IT AT ALL. THE WHOLE TIME THIS WAS GOING ON I WAS ON THE PHONE WITH MY BEST FRIEND WHO WAS WITNESSING THE SAME ORB OF LIGHT THAT WE WERE. SHE SAID THE ORB WE SAW WAS THE EXACT SAME AS THE 3 SHE HAD JUST SEEN..

summary: 3 white light triangle shape, 2-3,000 ft south with west heading turned north then turned west.  No sound traveling very slow
description:
Saw an object south. Traveling slow turned and headed north and traveled directly over us. Was three white lights in triangle shape. 
Had no sound, appeared to be very low 2-3,000 ft. Was the size of a 747 wing span. 
Could not see any color just looked like the craft was invisible. 
Traveled over us then turned west with a weird banking turn, not like a plane would turn.

summary: 7-4-12, daytona beach,fl.
description:
7-4-12 ,We were at the 1300 block of N. Atlantic Ave in Daytona Beach, FL. It was about 10 pm when we saw the first one about 1 1/2 miles to the south just off of the beach at the atlantic ocean. 
They just appeared, hovered and took off to the east and disappeared. They seemed to follow the same flight pattern for about 30 mins. 
I have one picture with 2 of them. Please let me know if anyone else saw them

summary: LOOKED LIKE A UFO
description:
we were in the local soccor field in warrenton we had looked up to see a glowing reddish orange object. no blinking lights -- as a plane would have - no sound - it moved slowly across the sky going towards seaside and we watched for about 3 minutes then all at once it was gone . 
it was not a firework there were no fire ambers burning below it !! 
and it was going across the sky -- not up in the sky .. we got a picture on a cell phone but not good ...

summary: White-orange lights, in row, slowly crossing sky
description:
At Compo Beach, after the annual Westport 4th of July fireworks display, my son and his friends observed five lights moving across the sky.
A little over a week ago, on 06/25-2012, my wife reported a dramatically similar phenomenon at this same location, and reported it to NUFORC. My son and friends were also there at the earlier occasion and saw the lights then too. According to my son, this sighting was pretty much the same thing as he had seen previously, except this time the lights appeared to be higher in the sky. In the first sighting they appeared very low.
Since I'm reporting this 2nd hand, I hesitate to provide more information. But my son took a short video which I will email to NUFORC.

summary: Several witnesses to strange "Patriotic" lights over 4th of July Holiday, many photographs.
description:
I would like someone there to check this out & see what they can make of it, if you will.
Myself as well as several others were here celebrating the 4th & happened to notice the full moon, one deciding to take some pictures with his fairly expensive camera. Nothing incredible showed up at first glance, but then the photographer decided to zoom in & started getting different sized red, white, & blue lights appearing in the digital photographs, which were not apparently visible through the camera scope alone, nor to the naked eye.
He showed a few others his pics, & upon seeing them I ran to get my telescope. It is not much for a tele mind ya, but I couldn't see the objects with it either. We took turns looking through the tele as the photographer continued taking pictures, almost all of which captureded these mysterious lights, but in different locations each time, as if they were moving. I messed with the digital images on my pc some, magnifying some pictures to try & gain a better understanding of exactly what we may be looking at.. but retained the originals as well as their filenames when saving magnified images.
I'm not in a good situation financially at the moment, so mailing…

summary: Traveling orange flame or light
description: Watching fireworks outside of my home around 10:15 PM, I looked to the left of me in the sky and seen a red glowing flame or light that traveled at high speeds. First it appeared low but not low enough to make out the object. It traveled passed us over the sky, traveling higher. I turned briefly and then back and it was gone. There was no noise involved and it not resemble an airplane. The three of us that had witnessed this was confused and wondered what it might have been.

summary: Multiple glowing objects flying South down Puget Sound
description:
I live in West Seattle about 1/4 mile South of the Fauntleroy ferry dock. About 9:30PM last night two friends and I went up on my roof and sat in chairs facing West, giving us a sweeping view of Puget Sound, Vashon, Baimbridge and Blake islands and the Olympic mountains. It was twilight, and there were multiple fireworks going off both on our side of the Sound and across on the islands.
Suddenly all three of us noticed two bright reddish orange lights flying southward, in tandem, down the Sound. I would estimate that they were at 5,000 feet altitude, flying slightly faster than a jet, maintaining equal distance from one another, and completely silent. They were about the size of a large jet, but were just glowing lights, with no visible structure. As they flew over the North tip of Vashon Island, they both appeared to slow down, and the one that was slightly ahead began to dim. They continued on their course until we could no longer see them (behind some trees in my yard). We were amazed and were discussing what they possibly could have been when another light, this time solo, followed the exact same path down the sound. At this point, I ran down to grab some high powered…

summary: Saw numerous red-orange objects moving slowing in north to south and also south to north directions over a 20 minute period in Seattle during Lake Union fireworks display.
description:
Was on a party boat with others out on Lake Union waiting for the fireworks to begin (no drinking!). Saw the first (and single) object moving slowly from north to south directly over our head. At first thought it was a helicopter, but had an orange/red glow and no navigation lights and no sound. Then thought it might be an airplane at high elevation catching the sun. It moved south and then disappeared; thought it may have gone into the shadow of the earth.
Perhaps 10 minutes later saw two similar lights/objects moving from south to north and far to the south. Very close together it seemed – and too close to each other to be airplanes. They disappeared as they moved to the north. Which seems odd if they were entering the earth’s shadow, as the first object disappeared as it moved south. There may have been one or two lights/objects off to the east at this time.
Then during the height of the Lake Union fireworks show about 15 minutes later there were numerous lights/objects (five?) far off to the east moving north to south, with two of the objects close together. They disappeared as they moved slowly to the south, but did not disappear at the same time, and also did not disappear…

summary: Fireball In The Sky!
description:
It was moving slow enough that we thought it was an aircraft of sorts but between the fireworks going off, we, the group of us, could not hear anything. We shared binoculars to take a look at this spectacular light in the sky. 
My daughter says she sees them frequently when she is out with her telescope checking out the stars. I wouldn't say it was completely circular but more like a sideways egg that was glowing reddish-orange. This lasted about 20minutes before it just glided away back into the atmosphere. Oh yea and there were several aircrafts in the area since SeaTac is just across the valley from us.

summary: RED/ORANGE ORBS ACCROSS THE NIGHT SKY
description:
I WAS OUTSIDE WATCHING THE FIREWORKS WHEN ME AND 2 OTHER WITNESSES SAW ONE UFO HEADING EAST. IT WAS BEAMING RED AND THEN TURNED ORANGE. IS CONSTANTLY CHANGED ONLY THOSE TWO COLORS. WE SAW THIS FOR ABOUT 10 SECONDS, IT WAS MOVING REALLY FAST. THEN A SECOND RED/ORANGE ORB HEADING EAST AGAIN. THEN A THIRD ONE CAME ALONG HEADING EAST AS WELL. WE AREN’T SURE IF THIS WAS THE SAME UFO GOING IN CIRCLES OR IF THEY WERE FOLLOWING EACH OTHER. 
AFTER WE WITNESSED THIS I CALLED MY BEST FRIEND AND INFORMED HER OF WHAT WE JUST SAW. SHE AND HER BOYFRIEND EMEDIATELY RAN OUTSIDE AND WAS LOOKING IN THE SKY. ABOUT 2 MINUTES LATER THEY WITNESSED THE SAME KIND OF ORB WE ALL SAW. THIS ONE WAS HEADING NORTH FOR ABOUT 5 MINUTES AND SHIFTED EAST. MY FRIENDS AND I SAW THE SAME ORB WHICH WOULD HAVE BEEN THE 4TH ONE WE SAW THAT NIGHT AT THE SAME TIME MY BEST FRIEND AND HER BOYFRIEND SAW IT. (WE LIVE ABOUT A MILE APART)

summary: red/orange fireball in sky ...but 2 of them? lasting 7 minutes
description: Listening to fireworks as the woods hinders our site of them. In the sky high up we witnesses a large red/orange type fireball go complete stretch of sky in straight line with no sound , did not look at all like a comet. looked like one huge red/orange spotlight on and never flashing. As it went far east, it circled and then went out. within a matter of 3 minutes the second one came from tree line and changed speed, went from very fast to slower but in same direction flickering...not as plane but a fireball . Went length of sky and turned east to then south and then spat out. There was no way these were fireworks as they straight level in sky , never changed altitude, did not fall to ground or fizz out , they circled. estimate 3 minutes apart from first sighting to second.

summary: Four lights hover in sky, followed by fireballs circulating the night sky.
description: My eleven-year old son was watching fireworks from our back deck when he called me (his mom) and dad outside because he saw some lights. I didn’t think much about it because it was the fourth of July; however, he pointed out four unusual red/orange lights that hovered in unison from the east to west direction. Our back deck faces north. It was peculiar to see these lights drifting slowly from east to west against the night sky when there were plenty of fireworks. The first three set of lights were in a triangle shape with the fourth trailing behind. We then called our oldest 17-year old son to see these lights and ask what he thought about them. Shortly after he came to see them we noticed that the first three set of lights in a triangle shape lost the first bottom left light, as it simply disappeared. Our 17-year old also agreed how odd the lights appeared. We noticed some airplanes to the southeast of us, and we could slightly hear their engines. The light! s hovered together and kept in the same distance for some time. The lights began to trail behind a set of trees and as we moved to see if we could see them we noticed that the remaining two from the triangle disappeared, but…

summary: I saw a red orb/sphere traveling from north to south.  The object was traveling towards me. The object was about 1-2 miles high, and turned gradually to the east.  The object seemed to accent…
Three orange-red objects were circling over Arlington,WA. on Fourth of July.
description:
Two and sometimes three red and sometimes red and yellow lights traveling in mostly the eastern sky at various speeds from stop to fairly fast. Quite a distance from us and varied from about 5 degrees to 60 degrees high in the sky. No sound but probably too far away to hear if there any sounds. Sometimes they were completely stationary for a time and instead of moving on they would fade away. Later they would reappear in another part of the sky and cruise toward the original location of the first sighting ( gathering place?) T
he first appearance of the third light appeared to originate at ground level halfway down the side of a forested hill about a mile away from our house. It rose slowly and steadily (like an elevator) to well above the horizon to join the other two. Then they all faded away. After that you could expect to see them appear just about anywhere in the sky.
If you let your imagination run a bit, it was like they were curious about all the fireworks going on as they often seemed to collect and completely stop above a specific location that had the most fireworks activity and artificial light. Our neighbor observed most of this activity also and helped search the…

summary: Seven people saw 4 orange fireballs flying very fast in formation.  There was very little wind and no noise!
description:
We saw four orange transparent spheres,no noise ,moving very fast, very little wind and looked like fire in the sky. They were flying in formation. 
About a hour later I called my brother, he lives about 12 miles away from me and he said he saw the same lights! 
I can't tell you what these were but I never have never seen a plane with orange lights!

summary: Seeing two flaming orbs in the sky
description:
Right before the fourth of July fireworks there was two aircraft in the sky that looked like they they were fire orbs. I have an extreme history in experimental and civilian aircraft and have been to "Oshkosh" airshow many times (The biggest airshow in the world) and know 100% that this was NOT a man made aircraft. No aircraft are MADE to look like they are on fire or are on fire. 
After online research I realized this may be some kind of UFO, It's like they were just around to see our fireworks! To me if this is aliens it makes sense, they just wanted to watch like we do, but it's weird since we live so close to a military base that nothing was scrambled to see what it was that night unless they knew what it was, in that case, the GOV is up to some weird stuff, but if they come to my apartment after this I'll hopefully let you know!

summary: Orange Orbs over Bothell - up close and explained
description:
It has become expected that on the 4th of July we look upwards to view the infamous orange orbs. We saw more this evening around 10pm than any other year: probably about 6, each in it's own position. (Not in a group.) All sightings moved exactly the same, however. Silently and in the same direction (from the NW to the SE). Each had the same speed: guessing about 10 mph? All were also at the same altitude. Each also just suddenly disappeared while watching.
As noted, we have been mesmerized by this unique sighting for years and have posted UFO reports. Each year, however, we have only witnessed one over Bothell. This year was exciting as we saw many. As always, we see these on the 4th of July.
I can share we had a revelation this year as we experienced this orb up close and our understanding of what we have witnessed was changed. A new "firework" was avaialble for purchase at our local shop called the Chinese Lantern. We set 3 of these off ourselves: one red, one orange, and one pink. Each had a fire actually in flame which raised this 2 ft long x 1 ft long paper lantern directly up. It moved SE as the wind came from the NW. It floated quickly up and the higher it got the faster it…

summary: Orange, oval objects seen over Rogers, Arkansas
description:
While watching neighborhood fireworks in my back yard, I noticed an orange oval object in the sky heading north. It was about a mile up, and was just east of my house. There was no sound coming from the object nor were the lights blinking. 
About a minute later, I saw another one coming almost directly over my house. Again, it was silent and no lights were blinking. It was heading north as well. 
It got past my house about 1/2 mile and disappeared in the sky.
I am a 61-year old professional woman who is not on any medication or alcohol.

summary: Numerous blue flashing dots in sky moving in sky.
description: Many strange moving blue lights in the sky that moved across the sky in a arch over time. Started out with smaller numbers than it seemed to increase in numbers and file into a line over a large portion of the sky, blinking irregularly. They then congregated once again moving about irregularly. They were gone after I went inside for 20 minutes.

summary: Red orbs flying then disappearing
description: Me, my friend, and her mom and dad were walking down the street after the fireworks when my friend pointed out a red circle in the sky that we thought might have been a planet or a star going out, but then it started moving. We watched it move over a line of trees, slowly towards the left and then after about a minute it disappeared. We started talking about how weird that was and how it might have been some leftover fire works when another orb that looked just like the other one, red and bright, came from the exact same position and moved exactly like the other one. We videoed it and watched it go to the same place the first orb had gone and just like the other, after about 1 minute, it disappeared. No other orbs came into sight after the second one vanished.

summary: Two red circles appearing out of nowhere, then disappearing.
description:
Me, my mom, and my friend were all walking back to our house and I looked up because something in the sky caught my eye. I immediately looked to my friend and said, "Oh my gosh, what is that? Is that a planet; is it Saturn since it's red? No, is that an airplane? No... it's not either one…"
Then she looked up at it and seemed to be just as confused as I was. This object was bright red, unmistakably red. Also, it let off a hazy kind of light. I was honestly baffled at the site and looked to my parents for their opinion, expecting them to not think it was anything out of the ordinary. Then as they took a look, they both agreed that it was in fact NOT a plane, burning star, planet, or anything of a cosmic sort. I quickly took a picture with my iPhone to then find that it disappeared shortly after. It went from right to left, almost in a diagonal line. We stood there, shocked. Then only about ten seconds later, another red circle appears. My mom pred! icted that this one would follow suit and disappear like the last one. However, I videoed this one for a minute and 16 seconds. I started the video about ten seconds after I saw it and then videoed it until it vanished. It seems as…

summary: Fire colored sphere in Pottstown.
description:
On July 4th we were parking in Pottstown, in an alley, behind a friends house. The alley is in between 4th and 5th streets. Our friends met my fiancé and I in the alley as we were getting out of our car. Our one friend looked up and said “what is that? What the hell is that”. 
We all saw a sphere shaped object that looked to us to be about 500 feet above the ground. The object was almost right above us. The sphere was glowing bright orange , the color of fire. There was no noise and there were no blinking lights like on an aircraft. 
The object was moving in a straight line with a slight hesitation at times along it’s path. 
The sphere was moving from West to East. 
The object stayed in our sight for about 3 minutes until we lost sight of it.

summary: Bright red light with no sound that move across the west sky.
description:
Saw bright red light appear over treetops from the southwest. Initialy thought it was fireworks (Roman candle) as it rose into the sky. However, it continued to rise and move from the south to the north about 60 degrees above the west horizon until it move out of sight to the north.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: See above
description:
Sent an email with a picture. This red circular object hovered above hwy 181. A total of 6 of us saw this as we drove on 181. This bright red thing hovered as it descended to the ground and disappeared lasted a good 40 seconds before it vanished into the ground. 
My snapshot showes a metallic looking sac with 3 metallic balls in it to the far right of the photo. This is not a flare ..not a firework not smoke and not a helicopter ,,, we ruled out Ll those explanations... 
Call me crazy but it was scary and real..

summary: Ball of fire in the sky twice in one night.
description:
We were getting ready to shoot off some small fireworks for the kids when my husband noticed a strange light in the sky. Myself and my neighbor got up to look and it looked like an orange fireball. There were no flashing lights as if it were a plane, You could not see any shape to it to make us think it was a plane. There is an air strip very close to our house so we see planes regularly. It was just a ball of light high in the sky. It went from East to West and then we lost sight of it. 
Later that night about 10:30pm we saw it again from our back porch. It was moving slower this time and almost hovering. We went into get the camera but as we were trying to find a setting to take a decent picture in the dark it disappeared.

summary: Glowing Orange Sphere over Toppenish, WA.
description:
On July 4th, in Toppenish, WA my father, mother and I were waiting in our auto for the fireworks display to begin at the local casino. To the west of us, about 20-degrees from the horizon appeared a large orange sphere glowing brightly, at 9:44pm. The object may have been 20 miles away. An aircraft was seen nearby with its flashing lights. The large orange sphere appeared larger than the aircraft. My father and I both spotted it. My mother saw it as well.
The large orange sphere just glowed and hovered in place, maybe moving slightly to the right, north-easterly direction. After one minute it blinked out. The nearby aircraft moved on to the south-east.
10-minutes later at 09:55pm, the orange sphere appeared again in roughly the same location in the western sky. It hovered for around 2 minutes then blinked out again.
20-minutes later, at 10:20pm, the orange sphere appeared again in roughly the same location. After about one-minute, it quickly faded out. There were no clouds in the sky that night. There were many cars around us also waiting for the fireworks, but we did not talk to any of the other people around.
The orange sphere was very similar to the one I spotted in Seattle,…

summary: UFO mimicking fireworks
description:
I think I just saw a UFO?! Yes, yes.... I know it's the 4th of July and everyone is shooting off fireworks – At 9:45pm, I was heading north on Harvard Ave. near Pine St. and I noticed this sparkly orb in the sky about a 1/2 mile up, I thought to myself "That's a cool firework" -- but it just hung there and kept changing colors. "Well, maybe it's one of those with a Parachute attached too it?" 
I got to Harvard and Apache and it was still there, so I pulled over and got out of my car, looked at it for about 10 seconds and it was changing colors and all... then a large burst firework went off in the sky about a half block to my right -- then suddenly, in a blink..the orb shot north about a 1/3 of a mile, paused, in less then a second, it then took off further north about 5 miles -- then it was gone. I thought to myself, "That was no firework, plane, or helicopter... I think I just saw a UFO -- and it was mimicking the fireworks?!" 
Weird! Anyway, being the artist that I am, I duplicated what I saw, and it's dead on! (I will send an email of this)

summary: Observed a firey orb on a southwest heading out of the northeast during Bolingbrook fireworks show.
description:
We viewed these orange fiery orbs traveling on the same southwest heading from the northeast. They were traveling at a high rate of speed on the same, straight vector. They passed, from our persective, directly over the Bolingbrook, IL fireworks Fourth of July fireworks show as it performed, so thousands must have seen them.
The orbs were at full brightness, magnitude ten. The light was constant until it passed far down range and then it instantly extinguished. I have looked at every single aircraft I see in the sky, night and day, for twenty years and I’ve never seen anything like this. I also am an amateur stargazer, and have watched satellites and iridium flares for years. This was not like any of those. It appeared to be in orbit, but was generating its own light.
There were no other observable lights, just one big fireball.
It made no audible sound.
I’ll be filing a separate report on our seeing one identical object on 07/07/2012 at approximately the same time on the same vector.

summary: Red/orange fireball moving slowly

On Independence Day 2012 at 9:45 pm i was sitting on the roof of the garage with my fiance and his parents about to watch the fireworks. I saw a large reddish-orange fireball moving very slowly to the northeast, without any sound. After about 5 minutes it disappeared.
There are hot air balloons in the area that travel short distances. However, this was well after dark, and i have never seen any hot air balloons in the area past dusk (it was dark enough to see the stars by this point, and fireworks started within the same time frame).
Also every time i've seen hot air balloons they have been accompanied by loud rushing/roaring noises from the flame and gas burner.
I have yet to see if any hot air balloons might have been up at that time of night, in that specific area.

It was still somewhat daylight also. I took as many photos as I could, my hands were so shaky after I saw this thing it was hard to stay stable. I have witnessed objects before that I have never reported out of reluctance or fear to do so. What was different this night is that more came as the night went on. Soon after the first one I noticed, I looked to the south of where I stood and I noticed a bright glowing object slowly moving in my direction. Where I live I have! a ton of trees all around me so trying to photograph these things is difficult. Behind and to the left of the first fireball looking object followed another one and another behind that one. Then from behind the view of the…

Without saying a word to each other, both my husband and I stopped walking trying to figure out what we were looking at. The location did not coincide with Hollywood Intl. Airport or the Fort Lauderdale executive airport. The red lights were too far and too bright to be planes. We are about 10 miles from Hollywood Intl. Airport and could actually see planes heading in that direction so we could clearly compare the plane’s flashing red lights with the constant red light hovering at a fixed location in the sky. After the lights disappeared (not faded, just disappeared) my husband just said that was probably our first ! UFO sighting.

My husband tried to convince everyone that it was a Chinese candle balloon, but the funny thing was the last time we looked back at it before it was out of our view, you could see two planes flying towards it-all of which looked like ants in its giant comparison. 
I'd say the light could've been at leas!t half the size of the moon.

They resembled Chinese lanterns floating in the sky, IF they had been on fire. I was thinking, "Why aren't they racing upward to explode like they usually do? Why are they so slow?" I asked my cousin, "What ARE those!?" 
Then we noticed they weren't going up, they were moving sideways, and I thought it was weird that they seemed to be "caught in the wind" and moving away from where the fireworks would be. They were moving slowly to the Northwest, at approximately 20-30 mph. Everyone around us was staring at them, trying to figure out what they were. They were reminiscent of ta! il lights on a car, but far apart from each other. Also, they were hovering rather low, which is the other reason I discerned they weren't fireworks. Low, slow moving, and non-exploding.
We watched them for no more than 5 minutes…

I was about to brush them off as someone in the nearby neighborhood shooting off fireworks, until they continued to move closer to where we were standing. 
Mesmerized by them, I continued to stare, but managed to get a couple of quick photos with my cell phone. They appeared further away than they actually were in the photo. It would have been easy to dismiss these as Chinese paper lanterns, had they not been SO bright and moving sideways and not at an upward incline at all and it was not windy. 
I turned for two seconds to say something to my cousin, and when I looked back to where they were, they were completely gone.
The two of us had both completely forgot about this within minutes, until the next day when her brother in-law came to pick up his children and mentioned he saw the same thing, too. Only he was at least thirty minutes away in Garland.
The objects we saw are what I am thoroughly convinced to be UFO's, especially after seeing DOZENS of descriptions from all over the…

The first object was sort of in the shape of an E with the E facing down at the ground. It did not change orientation at any time. The second object was in the shape of an elongated cylinder that was oriented horizontally relative to the ground. It did not change orientation either.
Both of the objects were the same color... I would describe it as a brushed stainless steel... there was no appearance of a polished finish.
