I continued to watch this orange orb move east and it visually changed direction and then headed south over Oregon. This happened a few minutes past 10:30pm. After we initially noticed the orb, I witnessed it in sight for roughly 5-6 minutes. There were 4 other people who witnessed this event with me.
A few weeks ago, a co worker of mine told me that she witnessed the same type of objects flying overhead while she was camping. This is one reason why I took any regards to taking a photo and making a report. What I saw directly related to what she reported seeing to me. description:
Around 10:20 pm we were outside sitting in our pool. We live southeast, just outside of Wanamaker, IN. We saw first one very bright, unflickering, orange fireball/light. It looked like it might have been a misfired firework, but it continued moving east without losing altitude.

There were airplanes in the sky before and after we saw this, and they looked completely different-- I was thinking maybe the air quality or smog was distorting the lights, but that didn't seem to be the case. 
Oh, and there was no noise coming from them, and they all came from the same exact direction in the sky- northwest.
We have corrected the time of the sighting, in order to reflect an nighttime sighting. PD

summary: Twelve small reddish objects crossed in a left to right pattern over Lake Leelanau

There were many watercraft in the lake as well as many spectators watching from their homes or the beach. 
My husband became excited and told me to look down the south end of the lake. 
I observed a small, reddish orange light floating above the lake. I would guess that it was about 1000 feet up in the sky, but I do struggle with measuring distances, as I did not have my glasses on at the time. 
I watched as another followed the first. I cocked my ear upwards attempting to hear a motor noise and heard absolutely nothing. 
All in all, there were at least 12 of these small objects that I observed.

I could just barely make out the shape of the thing and think I could see a missle or cigar shape with no wings or rotors visible. The light on the underside more or less obscured the actual craft. 
I strained to hear any sound and I may have heard a very faint hissing sound as it passed over. 
It continued in a straight line to the southeast and eventually dissappeared in the night sky. 
I will add I've never see anything like this before and have seen countless helicopters and aircraft large and small over the years.

Having some flight experience, I found it odd that there was no sound for an object that was at such a low altitude. The light emitted by this craft was red, and slightly pulsating. 
I was unable to ascertain any specific shape to the craft, but it was small. There was no cloud cover to account for the immediate disappearance of the craft. It did not change altitude during our sighting. It was not seen again after that.

summary: Large, disk-shaped object hovering above a nearby house—no more than fifty feet above the roofline.

When I was twelve years old, a group of friends and I snuck out to spend time together and walked around our neighborhood. During that walk, we noticed a large, disk-shaped object hovering above a nearby house—no more than fifty feet above the roofline. The craft had a distinct circular form with what appeared to be lights on its underside. It made no sound, showed no visible means of propulsion, and remained motionless in the air.
We stopped in our tracks and stared at it, stunned by how unfamiliar and out of place it looked. After several moments, the object suddenly accelerated straight upward and vanished into the night sky in a fraction of a second. The speed of its departure was unlike anything we had ever seen.
We were terrified and immediately ran home. The incident left a lasting impression on me and on the friend who witnessed it alongside me. Even now, the memory is vivid and difficult to reconcile. With the increased public discussion and reporting of UAPs in recent years, I felt it was appropriate to document this experience formally.

The film appears to be shot from another helicopter from a considerable distance, and the object appears to be moving too fast to be a bird, and since it is partially obscured by smoke as it emerges, it seems too far away to be a bug or dust.
I do not have access to the footage, but maybe the producers at the Ed Show can steer you in the right direction. This footage appeared on the last 2 minutes of the June 29th edition of MSNBC's 'Ed Show'.

While almost directly overhead, they appeared to be flying low and slow. If lights were not low, then they would have had to be huge.
 Saw another light following first lights, then another, then another. All moving in straight line toward Long Island. Pulled car over to watch as more lights continued to add to the widely spaced procession of lights. Fifteen to twenty in all. Car windows rolled down, but could hear no sound. Another car stopped at a stop sign - not moving - as lights flew by.
 Returned home and texted my son who saw them also, but said they looked red to him.

They appeared in sequence crossing from northwest to southeast in this pattern: five together in a triangular shape, followed by a pair and another pair and, finally, a single light. They were distinctly orange, moving rapidly, but not apparently at terrifically high speed; there was a complete absence of sound. After they passed over us, they disappeared – apparently accelerating away soundlessly. In relation to other objects in the night sky, they were much larger than stars, and seemed large for their elevation.
 My grandson was able to use a digital camera, not a cell phone, to record most of the event. We have uploaded the 2 minute, 13 second video to a laptop computer. I will submit that file soon.

They were moving together in what looked to be perfect synchronization. Having seen the International Space Station earlier we knew that it couldn’t be that. summary: Orb of light flew across the sky, airforce planes circled area of spotting.
description:
Green orb appeared in the middle of sky, west of grand forks, and floated across the sky, then stopped for a few seconds and then disappeared. Moments after Airforce planes took off from grand forks airbase and circled the area where the orb disappeared for over an hour before heading back to base.

description: Single steady bright white light, no flashing green, red or white light. Did not appear to be very high in sky. No sound. Traveling from WNW to ESE.

summary: One object, blob shaped, fire on port side, silent,in view 4 minutes-went dark,turned grey then black, 06/20/12, 22:45ish
description:
On corner of 40ave and 112 a st, Edmonton at twilight, a dark blob like object came into view to the SW of us. It travelled NE slowly and as it passed overhead, there was a glow, like fire, on the port side, -like a burner. But it was dead silent. 
We watched for about 3 minutes.  It then veered NW and the glow burned out- and the object went all grey. It was after that point silhouetted against setting sun and seemed black and round. There was no balloon, blimp, or anything I recognized. It was not a shooting star nor a toy rocket.   
Observers were one teacher and one senior. 
No alcohol, no drugs-out walking dogs. I estimate 22:45, as I had no watch-but arrived home (one block)-at about 22:50.

summary: Red flame flying through the sky.
description:
I live in the Geist area of Indianapolis and I work in Marketing for a large corporate law firm. I'm not a UFO chaser but did just see something strange in the sky.
 I was taking out the garbage and off to the south of my house I saw a light that caught my eye. It travelled north for about 1 minute. It was about as high as a low flying plane and it disappeared before it should have left my sight. It moved very steadily and in a straight line. The only way to describe it is it looked like an emergency road flare flying across the sky. It was red and steady but it flickered a bit and was moving quickly. It went over my street, right above me then as it went past, it was gone. I've seen flares shot that float to earth on the little parachutes and it looked exactly like that except it was moving fast and in a forward direction.

summary: Bright light that dimmed out
description:
The sighting occurred on June 20th at around 10:20pm in Northern Idaho. I was looking at the stars and noticed a very bright star at about 30 degrees off the horizon straight south. It looked about 5 times larger and brighter than the next brightest star in the sky. It looked like it was moving very slowly to the west and then a flashing light that appeared to be a plane passed a few degrees below it going east. At that point the bright star seemed to reverse course for a very brief period and then dimmed out at about the speed you would see a light on a dimmer go dark, not instantly. It was then completely gone. Perfectly clear night. The entire sighting lasted maybe 10 seconds. I watched the area of the sky for another 10 minutes or so and never saw anything else. If I didn’t see the movement, which was very minimal, I would think I had just witnessed a star go supernova. Although, I have no idea if that would dim out that quickly.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

summary: Orange fireball seen in Tonawanda NY
description:
We were sitting outside on the front patio, when someone looked up and said "What is that?" and we all looked up to see this bright orange fireball travelling very quickly across the sky.
The fireball did not lose altitude or speed as it flew across the sky. We were able to see it until it traveled out of sight. A few of us insist the object seemed to simply vanish while some of us think it flew beyond distance of our sight. It appeared to gain some altitude as it went along. There was no sound we could hear, and there was no diminishing of the color or brightness, and no apparent trail behind it.
It was flying lower than a plane would, and we live fairly close to the airport.

summary: Glowing sphere, hovering and then dissipating in close proximity to human beings
description:
A single craft was observed when I was sitting in a field outside my friends home. 
We were playing a game of man hunt and my partner and I decided to hide in the field directly in front of his house. As we were sitting in the tall grass, a bright blue glowing sphere about a cubic foot in size appeared about 10 feet in front of us and 40 feet above the ground. 
This sphere emitted a low hum, that seemed to shush the atmosphere around it, The owls, the crickets, and the frogs that had all been previously making noises stopped abruptly as soon as the sphere appeared. 
The sphere hovered for a mere 3 seconds and then quickly dropped 20 feet and dissipated into nothing 20 feet above the ground. My friend and I were in complete shock and have no idea what we have seen, but the owner of the home we were at says that once or twice a year the same spheres appear, hovering and then dissipating.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

He took pictures with his phone and a video. I can get him to send it if you wish.
Please can you help with this, we are in shock I think.

summary: Triangular object seen in Seaside, California (same object seen in Redondo Beach on YouTube 2011)
description:
My name is Christopher R.—I am a 54 year-old white male born February 5th, 1959 in Cleveland Ohio.
On the evening of Wednesday, June 20th, 2012 (the end of the solstice) at approximately 9:20PM I had just finished walking my dogs in Marina, California and was looking for a place to get something to eat in nearby Seaside (Monterey County). I passed Jim’s Chinese Restaurant on Del Monte Avenue next to Cardinalli’s used car lot on Broadway in Seaside. I parked my truck on the side of the street containing the restaurant (across the street from the Dunes Bar). I exited from my truck. As I turned to make my way to Jim’s, I saw in the air above the Dunes Bar what appeared to be four large, burning, pumpkin-shaped balls (for lack of a better description) hovering stationary.
The glowing balls in question soon revealed themselves to be anchored to a huge object in the shape of an isosceles triangle (approximately the size of a battleship). Three of the glowing balls were attached to the base of the triangle, while another appeared at the point (nose) of the object. The object soon began to move, following the uphill path of Broadway (southeasterly direction), cutting through the fog…

summary: June 20, 2012, Exeter, NH - slowly-moving red/orange lights traveling in a wavering line across the evening sky, then fading away.
description:
My husband and I were driving home to Exeter, NH around 9:00pm when we noticed a string of slowly moving red/orange lights in the sky. There was no sound, and the lights appeared to float in an erratic line, traveling from right to left above the horizon.
As they traveled across the sky, each light would get to a certain point and then slowly fade out then disappear completely. It seemed to us that they were turning so that we no longer saw the lights.
We reported this to a local police officer, who didn't seem concerned or interested. He said he would "call it in," but we saw no evidence of that. In checking the newspapers and online, there was no mention of it. The only place we've seen evidence of the same situation was on this website.
Witness indicates that the date is approximate. PD

summary: At approximately 8:15pm mountain time on Wednesday 6/20/12 I saw an Unidentified Flying Object over Denver Colorado.  There was a weather system moving from the south to the north. The leading edge…
description:
The object itself was white. It was triangular shaped. The leading point was farther away from the the 2 aft points making an elongated triangle. This object was moving very fast defiantly not fast enough to be an airliner. There was no sound. The light was very good. The sun was at a great angle to reflect off the object while being behind the clouds of the weather system. There was no trail or aura.
I am a enthusiast of military air craft. I know the difference in shape of most military air craft. This was not a fighter jet. This was not an F-117 or B2 bomber. I have a physical every year and my eye sight is checked at that time. It has been checked at 20-10 vision. This is better then 20-20. I can see very well. If I had to guess I would say this object was man made. I would say it is a lifting body possibly a space plane, a plane capable of flying from ground to orbit to back. I would guess it is the new spy plane to replace the SR-71 blackbird.

summary: Two bright balls of light ascending over forested area
description:
While on an evening hike, my friend and I witnessed two bright balls of light quickly ascending into the sky a few miles away from us. They were over a forested area that has minimal air traffic. They ascended at a steep angle, going from approximately 2,000 feet to 8,000 feet in about a minute and a half, with a slight wavering motion at times. Both of the lights went into a thin layer of clouds and disappeared. The cloud layer was thin enough that the lights should have been easily visible a couple seconds after passing through, but both disappeared in the same manner.
 The lights stayed a continous bright shade of white during the entire incident and didn't appear to be reflecting light from the sun, but were rather self-illuminated.
Witness indicates that the date is approximate. PD

A co-worker and I were curious as to what type of bird it was, so he went to get binoculars. As he returned with the binoculars the craft, definitely not bird took off at a high speed heading west, into the storm.

As I focused in and found the object in the eastern sky it was the same size, and shape craft moving silently, no con-trails, towards my and co-workers location. I asked my co-worker "remember that thing that was in the storm the other day?" and he responded with "yeah, that white thing up there?". I could not tell if the object was white, or was reflective, but I couldnt seem to focus on it completely. As we watched the…

It didn’t look like anything we’ve ever seen and the way it jumped from one side of the house to another so quickly made no sense to us. We looked out the windows then eventually went outside but didn’t see anything else. I lived there for 2 more years but never experienced it again. I’ve never been able to determine what it was but I wasn’t afraid. I’m not entirely sure of the date but I know it was late spring or early Summer of 2012 because my roommate moved out that Fall. summary: Bright Green Light With A Trail (Shaped like a Meteor) Descending Very Rapidly, then abruptly turning
description:
12:42 Scattered Cumulus Clouds at Approx. 6000’ I saw a vivid bright green light (looked like a meteor in regards to having a tail) travelling very fast from the sky at approximately an 80 degree angle to the horizon. It abruptly changed direction of travel to approximately 20 degree horizontal trajectory across the sky.
The object I saw was not free falling. It was travelling extremely fast and changed its trajectory without a variation in speed. I lost visual on the object quickly after it changed its travel path due to a bluff obscuring my view. I tried to approximate the object’s path of travel on the far side of the bluff and did not see the object again.

I wish I knew what this was! Amazing!

summary: Why was it necessary that a jet come from nowhere and deposited this contrail to dissapate  the rainbow object?

The colors were brilliant and several pictures were caught of the thing and then the jet intercepting it.
The short contrail which was left by the jet caused the rainbow to turn white and they could both be seen for about an hour later.

summary: Sighted 4 unknown craft flying at slow speed
description:
My wife and I were on our back porch. We saw three craft flying in a southerly direction and in an apparant formation. They were small, appeared far away, were traveling at a relatively slow speed, and leaving no vapor trail. They were an oval shape, not an elongated shape of an aircraft. These craft were to the southwest of us at about a 45 degree angle up from the horizon.
I then walked to the front of the house and spotted one craft that was similar, except it was much closer. It was traveling in a northerly direction. At the same time, I also saw a commercial airliner that was flying in approximately the same direction. It was faster and leaving a vapor trail.
The sky was a brilliant blue with virtually no clouds. Excellent visability.

summary: Man driving to work on Route 4 witnesses a gigantic craft hovering above roadway; other witnesses.
description:
Telephoned Report: A man had his employment supervisor call on his behalf. The witness, for some reason, hesitated to call.
The employee, who works in customer service, was driving to work on Highway/Route 4 in Springfield, when he noticed a gigantic craft hovering above, and straddling, the road he was on. He reported that the occupants of at least two other vehicles appeared to notice the object, as well, and that the cars were stopped on the edge of the roadway.
The witness reported that there were some very unusual lights on the ventral surface of the craft, which was hovering motionless above the roadway.
The witness reported that he observed the object for an estimated 2 minutes, and he then simply drove off.
Witness stated that he would submit a report within two hours, although NUFORC has not received the report, as of four hours following the telephone call.
We would welcome communications from the other alleged witnesses to this event.
Written report prepared by NUFORC. PD

summary: Triangle craft low slow silent
description: Driving down Rt. 666 toward Rt.11, I witnessed a large triangular craft moving East from which I thought at first was a star in the sky near dawn due to its front lights being so stationary. As I drove closer I could identify more than just the one front light "landing light"? and thought at first it could be a helicopter. Once it was over head I could make out the shape of the object I immediately pulled off and killed the engine to step out and take a better look. Personally being a pilot for several years I judge the lights if normal sized to give me an estimate of having been roughly 1,000 - 1,500 feet above the ground. It had four white lights on the bottom in a square pattern with a reddish tented front light. It was completely silent and moved very very slowly, again I estimate the speed to have been in the proximity of 13 knots give or take a few. I am not suggesting it to be extraterrestrial, but in all my years of been involved with aviat! ion, I have never seen anything like it past the stealth bomber if I had to compare, and never completely silent or able to move so slowly it seemed to defy gravity. Amazing equipment no matter the origin!

summary: Red orb UFO sighting in Farmington, Minnesota. 06/18/2012

So I watched it for about a minute and noticed it wasn't falling or leaving a smoke trail like a flare would. I grabed my phone to record it thinking it was a bit odd and watched it move higher and higher. Then it ended up flying towards me and right over me until it was out of sight due the the roof blocking the view.
It looked like a red orb floating in the sky. More like a flare that didn't shimmer. It didn't have a single flashing light like all aircraft have. There was some cloud cover in the sky and this light was under the clouds. It didn't make a single noise as it flew over me. A plane flew by short after and the lights on it wasn't as bright as the UFO, the plane made noise, and was a bit slower as it flied by.
I didn't know what to make of this. I searched on google to see if there was a similar sighing and I found one that was exactly the same as mine. The only difference was that the other sighting had 3 UFO's and mine was only 1. I don't have any pictures, but like I said above, I made a video. The video quality…

What really got my attention is the fact that I live in a very rural area with many cattle and at this time of night it is very common to hear cows bawling or mooing and there are ALWAYS frogs croaking. It was dead silent the whole time I witnessed the light.
I got my binoculars from my pickup and found the light and at that time also noticed it had a orange/red non blinking narrow cylinder type protrusion coming out the bottom of the white light. The protrusion was about 10% the size of the main light but 3 times the length. 
It then rapidly increased speed and quickly disappeared in the distance. It did always continue on a straight line trajectory but again it was lower in the sky than say a commercial jet and a much larger mass of light.

summary: Thirteen red lights travel same path over Wabash College in Crawfordsville, Indiana.
description:
I was sitting on my front porch and looked up into the sky above Wabash College and thought I saw a plane -- just looked like the red light but without the "blinker." About 10 seconds later, another followed....and then another....and then another. Thirteen in all from the time I started counting, all following the same path. No sound of plane/jet engines, and three simply disappeared (although they could have merely gone behind a cloud as it was partly cloudy that night).
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

I finished praying and got up and turned around when another fell due west of where I had been kneeling. The exact same size and color.

At certain point they formed a triangle in and then appeared to drop lose altitude together, remaining in the triangular configuration until we lost sight of them behind hills and objects at ground level. No engine noise whatever accompanied this event.

summary: Star like object appears next to Big Dipper and flies toward northern California';s Sierra Nevada mountains..
description:
I saw a second light adjacent to the lower right star of the Big Dipper's bucket appear at exactly midnight. The new light or star was just below and very close to Big Dipper's lower right side star, top outside of the bucket star. The Big Dipper is in the northwest sky to my position. 
As soon as I saw this new star adjacent to Big Dipper, I focused and watched intently. For approximately three to five seconds It appeared stationary then started moving toward me in a south easterly direction. It was the same brightness and size of the other Big Dipper stars. It flew relatively slowly across the sky and was easy to track. I watched it for 30 seconds and watched it fade out after it crossed California's central valley and approached Sierra Nevada mountains or above Auburn, California. I noticed It had some bulk to it as It got closer and overhead, like a square with rounded corners but still looking like a star. Looked at my watch after fade out, 12:01 AM June 18, 2012.

summary: Mysterious pink/purple orbs in the Chicago night sky traveling at great speed and high altitude.

But I was in error; the 'stars' were visibly two pink or purple lights, approximately two to three inches apart (using my fingers as a measuring instrument), one directly behind the other. The lights didn't blink, but they weren't constant, either. They appeared to pulsate, and the lights were rather dim. From the moment I first noticed them, their transit took approximately twenty to thirty seconds. I couldn't detect any shape of aircraft, there was no sound, and visibility was very good - no clouds or other distractions were in view. Given the precision with which the lights were following one another, I originally thought they might be emanating from one craft. But the second light suddenly picked up speed and either 'joined' the first light or flew frightening close to the first light as its 'wingman'. I have no way of determining the altitude these craft were flying but, given the clear…

summary: Very bright "star" fades and dissapears.

When I looked up I saw a bright light in the southern sky, roughly 50° - 60° off the horizon l have no reference or estimate for distance, but the light was similar to that of seeing a planet like Jupiter on a clear night. As I watched it, the light faded until it could no longer be seen. The whole event was very short (about 6 seconds) yet certainly grasped my attention.

summary: South San Jose, bright orb flying over mountains near Almaden Valley.
description:
I live in South San Jose (Almaden) and first spotted UFOs over the Sierra Azul Open Space Preserve on 16th June at 8.50 pm - my wife saw them too. I took this video (on my phone) the next night when just one UFO appeared at the same time, and hung around for 15 minutes. On both occasions, the objects emitted white, green and red slow pulsing light. They object in this video moves from side to side across the sky and at times soars high above the mountains in the distance. It's hard to see just how bright the light is from this video, but the objects really shone when at their brightest then fade to almost disappear before glowing again. I estimate the UFO is about a mile away from where I filmed this, which should be close enough to hear some sound from a conventional aircraft, but there was complete silence. This is the video link on YouTube: 
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=7ozPrVqc4dc.

location: Ocala (driving up I-75, location not exactly known), FL, USA
summary: Bright red light moving in a straight path across the sky, and suddenly vaporizing into thin air.
description:
I was driving North on I-75 in the Ocala FL area, although the precise location is not known beyond this. It was approximately 9pm, and it has just gotten dark. There was no cloud cover, so both stars and other planes could be seen in the sky quite clearly. This object appeared as a bright red light, fairly large and round compared to any other flying craft I have ever seen. It moved in a straight forward motion without flashing any lights. It seemed to be traveling faster than any plane or jet I have ever seen, but did not have any similarity to a shooting star, and it was not going down or up. These unique attributes caught my eye, but the real surprise was when the object suddenly vaporized into thin air. Again, there were no clouds in the sky, so it was quite surprising to see this bright object suddenly disappear with no trailing off or fading into the distance.
 This is the only time I could say that I have witnessed what appeared to be a UFO. There was no other significance to this event, at least nothing that was apparent to me.

summary: Red Hot Air Balloon looking UFO in Castle Rock, CO
description:
I was having lunch at the Rockyard Brewery in Castle Rock, Co. I stepped out for a smoke in front of the building. Directly across the street from the brewery, I saw what I initially thought was a smaller red hot air balloon moving slowly over the bank (don't know the name of the bank). 
As I watched it move away from the bank, I noticed the sun shining on it and saw that it was metallic. It was heading south at first, then changed direction in front of me and started heading east, gaining both speed and altitude. It was only about 50-60 yards away from me when I first saw it.
I called my friend to come out of the brewery to see it too, but by the time she came out, it sped up and was almost completely out of sight.

description:
My occupation as a truck driver did not prepare me for what I witnessed in the sky, behind where I live. I believe that my life-long interest of aviation however, has given me the ability to observe and determine the differences between conventional and non-conventional aircraft in flight.
It was 02:05, Atlantic Standard Time, in Dartmouth, Nova Scotia, when I stepped outside and into my back yard to have a smoke.
I was looking at the stars, as I often do, when they’re visible. That’s when I saw one of the stars moving at a fairly high rate of speed, South-East to North-West.
Of course, I thought this to be a shooting star at first but the rate at which it moved through the air seemed too slow to be that.
Then, to my astonishment, I noticed that the object was emitting a pulsating white light that engulfed it approximately every four seconds. The pulsations were also smooth. That is to say that it was like a dimmer switch being turned completely up, then back down again, to the almost off position. This dimmer effect would last about a second and a half between intervals. The object pulsated like that three times as it traveled across most of my field of vision.
It emitted no…

summary: Four triangular craft, three in formation, forth trying some stunts
description:
Two craft traveled east to west, entered my view from behind. Seconds after the first passed, two more craft joined into a formation. 
Three of the craft continued formation, the forth looped and zagged then returned to its place. The craft appeared to be typical airplane shape - the triangular shape of a planes wings; without the body of the plane.
Maybe like a stealth? The craft were bottom lit, the lights outlined the outside diameter, rather than one light on the tip, like the usual airplane. The lights were a soft amber.
None of us were able to hear engine noise.
During this sighting, we were able to look away from the craft, verify that each other were seeing the same thing, then find the craft on route.
Note, there is an air-force base to our north west, and to the west, a smaller airport.
However, these craft appeared to be too high to land at a strip so close by.

summary: 3 circular orange reddish lights in the shape of a triangle seen in Des Moines, IA near the State Capitol building.
description:
On June 16, 2012 at 11:27pm CST in Des Moines, Iowa, my friend and I were on the south side of the State Capitol building.
My friend saw three bright, solid orange reddish circular lights in the sky forming a triangle with the point on top. By the time I turned the corner, now heading north, we both saw that now there were only two lights side by side. We were on the east side of the State Capitol building now facing north.
The lights were stationary at about 40 degrees above the horizon. And we did not hear any noise. After parking the car and a quick look for my camera, there was only one left.
The last one lingered on for a bit more (5 seconds) then I was able to see it moving away heading east south east at a fast pace (another 4-5 seconds until I couldn’t see it any more.) The whole ‘event’ lasted around 35 seconds.
Recap: •	June 16, 2012 at 11:27pm CST in Des Moines, Iowa •	Majority of event viewed on east side of State Capitol building •	3 solid, bright orange reddish circular lights forming a triangle •	In the North sky – 40 degrees high •	One by one lights leaving •	Last one heading ESE at fast pace •	Event lasting around 35 seconds

summary: Dancing lights that would fly around and then merge into one light
description: We went to Morely Field in Balboa Park in San Diego to walk our dog at night between 10:30 and 11:00 pm. There are very few people in the park at that time because they close the parking lot and you need to park on a side street and walk into the park. It was a cool damp misty sort of night with clouds and lots of layers of atmosphere. We saw these dancing lights in the sky and at first tried to explain it--maybe strobe lights or reflections of some kind but nothing made sense. The lights would start from one source, then spread out and dance around and then return to the source light. The whole sky had a different quality to it, almost like a magnetic type of storm. This went on for 5-10 minutes, then the lights returned to their source point. I could still see where they were, it was a slight glow in the clouds, but they stayed there and stopped dancing. I had the feeling it knew we were watching. The source light was still there when we left the park. We ! have been back to the park several times since, but have not encountered those conditions or seen the lights again.

 I put on my hazards and pulled over to the side. I got out of the car and approached the onlookers. I took a look myself and didn't see anything except the flashing lights directly ahead, which appeared to me now a little less like "flashing lights" and more akin to "pulsing lights." I turned to the man on my left and asked him "what happened?" the man turned, looked at me, said nothing and then turned his head back to it's original position.

summary: 4 hovering orange lights on a cloudy night.  Seen by 7 people
description:
It was a cloudy nigh with no stars, planet, or moon in site. My brother, sister, and dad were enjoying a Father's Day dinner from our gazebo on my deck which faces the south but has a view to the west and east. What I figured about 10:20pm my sister and brother had gone inside and when they came back out to the deck my brother turned to his left and yelled, "What is that?!?" My initial thought was a a plane but I will look. From inside my gazebo I leaned down to see and saw 3 very large orange lights hovering in a triangle formation silently in the sky to our west. My dad and I quickly exited the gazebo and joined my sister and brother to run down to the yard to get a better view. That's when I noticed there were 4 and they were in a diamond shape. I called my neighbor over who was outside with her granddaughter and her friend. They joined us and we all watched for about 30 seconds as one by one they seemed to ascend into the clouds. By the time ! we saw them hovering the whole event was about a minute and a half. I'm sure they were there longer as they seemed to just be hanging out.

Its a fairly clear, quiet night and right after the sun went down, around 10:15. I have never seen anything like this and frankly a little spooked! 
Any ideas as to what it could be??

summary: We saw 5 to 6 orange glowing UFO's traveling in a row about 30 seconds apart across the highway.

The immediate thought was to see if the light was from the top of a tower such as a cell phone tower and to see if it blinked like one. The object did not blink and the bright light of the object was moving closer toward us. Then I thought that it might be an airplane since it was moving. I realized that it was not an airplane because it didn't have the small classic lights or blinking lights (red or white) that you see from an airplane in the sky. As the object traveled closer, I realized that the object consisted of a bright fire-like orange glow. I immediately found the closest side street off of the highway and parked my car. My wife stayed in the car but I grabbed my cell phone! , got out of the car and walked toward were the UFO was traveling overhead of us. I used my iPhone 4s to take pictures and a video of the UFO. While recording the object in video mode, my wife yelled out to me from the car…

summary: Orange fireballs in triangular formation in evening sky over Northern Bergen County on June 15, 2012

I orginally took it for the moon and thought it was odd to be located in that part of the sky. As I turned east onto Washington Avenue, I noticed another flaming ball in the sky. I thought they both were helicopters (despite the orange glow) and opened my window to hear the rotors. I heard nothing. I pulled onto my street and then into my driveway. Getting out of my car, I returned to the street and looked up. There were now three glowing, orange balls in a triangular formation in the northern sky. I called to a guest who was going into my home. As a retired police officer, I thought he might have an idea as to what the objects were. We watched them together. The objects appeared not to be moving and maintained this formation for 3 solid minutes as we discussed what! they could be. We then called to the others to come out and see, as we did the intensity began to diminish from orange to white and eventually faded from view.

I have no family history of schizophrenia or schizo-affective disorder although I do…

summary: We saw a white ball flying at a fast speed level to the ground at a height of 400 feet for five seconds.
description:
On approximately June 15th 2012 my wife and I were coming back from a restaurant in the Penn Yan NY area at approximately 8:30 PM when a white ball of light flew over our heads. We were in an automobile, the weather was clear, when from the Northeast going to the Southwest a white ball of light flew over our heads at a high rate of speed. 
The ball was flying at perhaps five times tree height. It was going at a level line with the tree line not at an angle with the ground. It was perfectly round and about 20 feet in diameter. It was a very white light going at a speed at least that of a jet. We watched it for only about five seconds. It had no flame or tail in back of it. There was no lightning or bad weather, skies were clear. We both saw it. It did light the area around it reflecting light off of the trees. Again it did not change elevation like a meteor would.

summary: Yorktown Beach on 6-15-12 we saw 5 or 6 lights flying seperately in the sky

The one light hovered and then in the blink of an eye there was another on beside it. The two lights then flew over each other and went in opposite directions. We watched them disappear into the distance and then in the original spot another light appeared. This light hovered and appeared to swing back and forth and then moved away and disappeared. Then another light appeared it hovered without moving and we watched until the light went completely out. It just went out like a light switch. It was the brightest light of all lights we saw and when it went out we were amazed. About a minute later we saw one more light hovering lower than the previous lights but it too just disappeared. We had not been drinking or smoking anything and there were no clouds in the sky and there were no stars yet. The sky was still blue.

summary: Glowing light that moved, stopped, glew brighter and dimmed out.
description:
About 3 or 4 years ago, I was walking with my dad to the store in Wenatchee, Washington, (which is a little town in the desert mountains) at about 7 or 8 at night, and I spotted a light with a little glow around it that was slowly moving horizontally. I watched it move for a few seconds while I was walking, and I stopped and pointed it out to my dad. We were watching it for about ten seconds when it stopped, grew brighter, and then it quickly got smaller and smaller like it dimmed out (my personal theory was that it warped away). 
I am certain it wasn't a meteor or a comet because of how slow it was moving, it didn't have a tail, and the fact that it stopped dead. The whole encounter was probably about 20 seconds. The thing that really freaked me out was that it seemed to disappear after we stopped and watched it, almost as if it was watching us. Either that or we just happened to encounter it just at the right time. 
Even though the encounter wasn't that much, I still get emotional thinking about what it could be that I witnessed.

• Shot upward from approximately 20 degrees to 45–55 degrees in the sky.

• Suddenly shot straight upward at a 90-degree angle and disappeared without fading.
• The entire event lasted approximately 8–10 minutes.

I saw it from the ground looking up, so I have no idea how tall it was, but it was wider than my house-much wider.
I do not expect anyone to believe me, because other than seeing lights moving through the night sky like the international space station. summary: Lights over Salem, Oregon
description:
We were outside on our front porch when noticed lights approaching at a fast speed. The object began to slow down, then hovered for about three to five seconds. Then the object quickly ascended approximately 20-30 feet then quickly descended to the original position. 
The object again hovered for a few more seconds then quickly moved to the right; faster than any plane I have ever seen. It made another quick right, stopped, hovered, then made a quick descend out of our sight. 
The lights were a yellowish-orange color that pulsated and changed to red. 
This has to be the craziest thing I have ever seen and I hope it was a UFO because I have never seen one before!

summary: Light cone emiits smoke blast.

the cloud continued to grow in size until touching the ground and reaching hundreds of feet in the sky. we thought it was a nuclear blast but heard no sound. and the cloud was nowhere near bright enough. 
we reported it to our command but they said it was an illumination round. 
I have been a mortar man for 10 years and I know what illumination looks like and that was not even bright enough for that. It was pitch black outside and the sky was perfectly clear except for this object. 
after the smoke cloud dissipated about 5 min later the object was gone and the light cone had shifted into a cloud as well and dissipated about 3 min after the large one.

I also got a strong sense that this object was triangular, perhaps equilateral. Moreover, it was quite large; much much larger than any aircraft I’ve seen before. The craft made no discernibly significant shifts in position, neither vertically nor horizontally. It just hovered. Situated over flat terrain, and above a heavily-populated, low-lying residential area, it hung in the night-sky at a relatively low altitude (much lower than planes departing from or approaching Sky Harbor).
I was driving south on I-51 at 10:28pm. As I approached Shea’s exit ramp I saw what I thought was an extremely large (and normal) aircraft off to the west; three large orange lights (what looked to be the lighted ends of each wingtip and nose). summary: Orange Fireball that fizzled out.
description:
I was driving on West Gulf Beach Drive and saw a glowing light in the sky. There are lots of wispy clouds here tonight and it was in front of the clouds. I noticed it because it never blinked like an airplane or moved after 2 minutes. It stayed in the same spot. It was completely orange and glowy, it never moved. I drove to West Gorrie Drive which is the road in front of the beach (this object was seen in the clouds on the beach side) to get a closer view. 
Again, it did not move it sat there as I stopped in the road. It finally fizzled out, the light went dim in a few seconds. It never moved, but went dim. I stayed in the area looking for any light/airplane a the clouds but nothing ever appeared again. The object was round in shape like a fireball, never blinking or moving, just glowing orange.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

description:
It was early morning twilight and I was walking from my trailer up to the main house. A small object came from my left and appeared to be a large white moth as it was diving toward the left side of my head. 
I quickly tilted my head to the right, to avoid its path, and as it flew passed my head, it turned into a bright disc about the size of a disc that is used in a track meet, about 6 inches across. 
It passed my head and picked up speed to maybe 200 miles an hour and as it flew through the tops of the alder trees, it turned vertically to avoid hitting the leaves and branches. 
It was gone and out of sight in less than five seconds.
In sight less than five seconds.

summary: Five orange silent hot air balloon shapes ascending the night sky.
description:
I'm a retired registered nurse. It was approximately 11:00PM EST on 06/6/12 and I decided to open the door to my east balcony and take in the night air. 
I looked directly east toward the mountain and approximately 1/2 mile away I saw what looked like a hot air balloon lit up with a orange glow floating silently up and away to the north through the clouds. 
As it ascended a second one appeared where the first one had started and it went up and away following the first ones trajectory. 
I ran and got my binoculars and it looked like the orange glow was much brighter in the bottom half of the hot air balloon shapes but I couldn't see any detail even with the binoculars. 
They were moving silently and quickly, disappearing through the clouds. The night was cool-63 degrees, no breeze, partly cloudy with some stars visible.
We spoke via telephone with this witness, and she sounded to us to be quite serious-minded. We suspect that she is a very good witness. PD

summary: Very bright light passing overhead at observational speed
description:
At approximately 10:15pm I went to retrieve my trash can and was prompted to look-up to the sky, instinctively. I immediately saw a very bright and fairly large light without sound slowly flying over my home at low altitude, heading due North. I could estimate its low altitude, as an airplane was passing in the background at a much further distance and higher altitude, from a diagonal perspective. The airplane had the standard pulsating lights.
The vessel was coasting at observational speed. 
As a student pilot, I conclude that it was not an airplane, as no flashing lights were active and neither the red or green orientation lights were apparent, as is featured on most aircraft wing tips.

At first, we thought it was something moving up the mountain but, realized it had traveled past the mountain, high into the night sky. It was not a completely dark night at the time. The fireball made a 90 degree turn and headed east. Suddenly, the light went out and we watched the object free fall. The object was much bigger than an airplane and it was falling freely, sort of wobbling about. It seemed to be between Teton Village and the town of Jackson. There were a few clouds in the sky and we watched it pass a couple of clouds until it got to a very dark cloud and we lost sight of it.
We headed on our way home, north on Highway 89. Suddenly, a fireball was coming towards us! It was large and not very high in the sky. summary: ((Woman's name deleted/wife)) and I were driving home on New Haven Ave, about 15 Minutes ago and observed what looked to be a UFO.  Not a Joke.  It was moving from southwest to northeast.
description:
We pulled over to the side of the road and got out to get a better look. No sound, not moving very fast what got my attention is the lighting. It was a red and orange cloudy glow with an uneven yellow border. Estimate it to be about 3000 feet doing around 250 kts. No white tail light or navigation red and green light. Another guy stopped to see what we were looking at and observed the same thing. 
We watched it cruise northeast bound until out of sight. 
Been an Air traffic Controller for 31 years and never observed lights like that.
We spoke with both witnesses, husband and wife, and they both sounded to us to be exceptionally capable, sober-minded, individuals. We suspect they are both very good witnesses. PD

We paused in our labors to admire the high jet contrails in the eastern sky, which still glowed a bit, catching the last of the light.
Facing East, the object appeared from the South, first one, then two, and finally three tiny but intensely bright red lights, so bright and pure red, they made me think of a laser's intensity. These were NOT beams, but strobing point sources of a light wavelength so narrow it made me think of a red Helium- Neon or diode laser. These were unlike any civilian or military running lights either of us had ever seen; nothing to indicate port, starboard, or leading edge. They were arranged in a rough equilateral triangle, one corner either canted toward or away from us. As we quickly ran through the possibilities, we told each other to remember as much detail as possible; this was something unique! As I passed the craft, I looked back and it disappeared. Pidcoke is a small town in between Copperas Cove and…

summary: White/Blue Unknown Craft in Forest Lake, MN

It had a bright, neon blue circle on the rear with a bright white light in the middle. Along the side of the craft, it was glowing white. The craft appeared oval to me but I saw it only for two seconds as it hovered, turned, then took off at a speed in which I cannot describe. It was there, then a bright streak, and it was gone. I am reporting this just 20 mins from the time it happened. I actually called Channel 5 Eyewitness News in the Twin Cities area to see if anyone had seen what I did, but they had not. summary: Weird star behavior.
description:
Tonight at about 11:45pm EST I think I saw a UFO. I was out watching the sky with my binoculars. I was looking at Mars in the western sky. I turned to the North to try and spot something I saw earlier. In the NW sky I saw a bright white light, and seemed to be round like a star. I thought it was a star until it moved.
Watching with my binoculars, it traveled straight East. It moved slowly at first, then began to pick up speed, then slowed down. It seemed to stop briefly, then continued on slowly. It did this several times. Finally it moved slowly towards the horizon, disappearing from my view behind a tree.
Other than the strange behavior mentioned above, I think it was a UFO since it made no noise. I had seen a UFO one other time, about 1975 in Akron OH. It behaved similarly and had no sound.
I have been watching planes and stars for many years. I know what’s obscure.
Witness elects to remain totally anonymous; provides no contact information. PD

We continued to observe it and noticed that it was moving west to east in a strangely rhythmic manner. It slowed down and sped up, repeating this every 2-3 seconds until it was finally out of sight around 5 minutes later.

I ran inside to get my camcorder, but it was gone by the time I got outside. I dismissed it as an optical illusion and forgot about it.

I ran inside to get my camcorder, and that's when I remembered that I had seen this same thing before. When I got outside and started filming, I was able to capture it, though it had apparently turned into a flashing orb hovering in the same location. It never appeared to move and eventually just faded away. The whole event lasted maybe 2 minutes. It all happened in the same spot in the sky. At approximately 10:15 p.m. on 06/02/2012 I noticed a large orange yellow globe rise over the horizon. I live in Cranberry Township, PA and it is a hilly area of Western PA. My first thought was that it was a hot air balloon on fire. As I looked it was followed by another. I called my husband and we both grabbed cameras. By the time the event was over, we observed about 10 of these orange fire balls go over. They were headed in a straight line, flying ENE from Pittsburgh.
We strung a few of our videos together and put two videos on YouTube. One is labeled “Missiles over Pittsburgh 06/02/2012” is probably the best one. The other “Cranberrytwpufo.qt” A search in YouTube should bring them up quickly. The Missile one has views from both my camera (I tried to do close-ups) and my husband’s cell phone video where he captured the things passing near the moon so you can get some perspective.
They were going fast, and we heard no sounds from them, although a helicopter did fly by while we were out filming. I really think it was a jet squadron being moved, but maybe someone can look at the pictures and see if that makes sense. We’ve all seen planes fly at night, but I’ve never seen 10 or so…

description:
Saw eight glowing orange fireball looking objects in the southern sky while i was moving a tracker trailer around on the lot at my job they moved slowly to the northwest.
There was no sound coming from the objects totally silent. The first four objects were in a diamond formation the next four trailed behind in a line.
They flew northwest slowly for around 60 seconds before they blinked out. All crafts blinked out in roughly the same spot.

summary: 10 to 15 red string of lights, then started moving and eventually moved individually and dissappeared behind a cloud.
description:
My son, his friend and I were coming home after an Intemidators minor league baseball game around 10 pm on saturday June 2nd. I saw what I thought was a new tower with several lights. However, the tower seemed to have lights to spread at the top on both sides which made me curious. 
I told the boys to look at it and they were amazed. It appeared that the lights began to move. They were a red color and circular in shape. They seemed to start spreading out in different directions and it was very weird. 
We arrived home and I went in to get my husband to come see. There was only 1 or 2 left in the sky at that time, but he did see one. My son and his friend said the others had moved to one spot in the sky behind a cloud and dissappeared. 
As we watched the last one move toward the same area as the others, it seemed to flicker. It then reached the same area and dissappeared in as cloud and did not come out on the other side. We of course wondered about airplanes but there would not be that many planes that close together or moving in different directions. We also thought maybe helocopters, but did not think again that there would be that many that close together.

summary: 3 orbs of light in formation above the ocean in a triangle formation
description:
I just submitted another story about a disk sighting that my same ex boyfriend and I witnessed about a month after this sighting. Both sightings were in the same area. One in broad daylight, this one late at night.
I was with my ex boyfriend sitting on the edge of the bluffs next to these abandoned apartments. (The exact same spot as my last report). This was about a month prior to the second sighting. We were there for about 30 minutes smoking cigarettes and talking when we noticed 3 orbs of light floating above the ocean.
They started in a triangle shape and held there for about 2 minutes. It was odd to see a literal triangle shape of lights just floating there above the ocean. Like deep out there.
After about 2 minutes, the 3 orbs started to move in circle motions and then crossing over each other, 3 turned into 5 and then into 7 and back into 3. The movements and orbs multiplying and them coming back into 3 was so bizarre.
We sat there for at least 10 minutes watching these lights. I actually had my phone out and recording these orbs. I had a 10 minute video capturing the orbs and their movements. The lights then disappeared, they didn't zoom off or anything, just turned off…

summary: Ten or more orange fireballs moving southerly along the east edge of Billings, MT.
description:
On June 2, 2012, approximately 9:45pm mountain time, I was summoned outside by my brother. I exited the house, and looked east, where my brother was pointing at something in the sky. Three orange fireballs were clearly visible moving in what appeared to be a southern trajectory, although it may have been southeast or southwest. The lights would have been near the eastern city limits of Billings Heights. As we watched the first three crossing the sky, more continued to come into view, as several large trees blocked part of the sky from our sight. I counted at least ten. Most of them seemed to be moving in a line with each other, althrough three of them formed an irregular triangle formation. At one point two of the orbs came close enough to eachother that they appeared to touch, before swirling around eachother for a moment. The lights all made their way across the sky, eventually fading into some cloud cover. The entire incident lasted less than 5 minutes.
The lights would best be described as orange fireballs. Their size was quite a bit larger than any star or planet would appear, and they were clearly visible even though night had not quite fallen and the sky was still fairly…

summary: Orange-red lights in the sky in Phoenixville, PA
description:
I was driving home at approximately 21:25 on route 724 in Phoenixville, PA when I saw a strange formation in the sky. I saw what looked to be a diamond formation in the sky of approximately 5-6 orange-red colored lights. Since I was driving, I could not get a clear uninterrupted look for more than a few seconds - but I kept looking up trying to determine if they were aircraft, hot air balloons, etc.
As I continued driving, I lost view of the diamond formation group of lights, but then saw a lower orange- red light that seemed to be moving across the sky at a steady pace with no blinking lights. I passed a person on the side of the road that got out of her vehicle and was looking up in the sky at the direction if the object.
As I continued to drive I kept looking at the object out of my driver side window. It seemed to be staying at the same distance while I was driving - keeping the view constant. I had a person driving fast behind me and I couldn't slow down to get a better look. I wish I did pull over to get a better look, as I had my camera with me (coming home from an event) and I kept trying to process what I was seeing.
This sparked my search this morning on the Internet to…

summary: Orange ball of light seemed to be floating with green flashing lights
description:
Saturday, June 2, 2012 Elk Grove, CA 9:20 PM -9:22 PM While I was watching TV, I saw a bright red-orange ball of light through my living room window. There was absolutely no noise. 
I thought it was a reflection from my TV onto the window at first. I then realized that it was in the sky. This orb seemed to be levitating. It proceeded from south or south-east to north-east. 
I ran back inside after watching it a moment to grab binoculars. On closer look, though it had traveled a considerable distance in just a short time, I was able to see green flashing lights.

summary: Strange Lights Across Cedar Rapids, Iowa Sky on June 2, 2012 @ around 9:15 pm CST
description: At around 9:15 pm CST (dusk), my neighbors and I witnessed a succession of about 12-15 bright, non-blinking large red lights, floating low on the horizon, across the clear, Cedar Rapids, Iowa sky following a NW to SE direction. First we saw three of the lights in a triangular formation, then a bunch more came in random spacing. This lasted for about 5 minutes, then one-by-one, they faded off the horizon. These WERE NOT aircraft or meteors (no sound), so what were these objects? I don't think they were satellites, since they were too low in atmosphere, too large, too many grouped together, and red in color instead of bright white. I called the local KCRG TV9 newsline shortly after this event, and they said they received other calls about these lighted objects. What was it? I tried to get a video, but my camera batteries were dead!

summary: Orange lights/balls over Tiger Mountain.
description: Just before 9pm I looked out to Tiger Mountain in Issaquah Washington (I live in Bellevue but have a nice view of the Cascade mountains and the city of Issaquah over Lake Sammamish)to the east. I witnessed 3 orange balls of light hovering over Tiger Mountain not in any specific formation but moving very slowly from side to side and up and down....again at a very deliberate pace. I watched this for a minute or two when the orange light on the right side went dark and I could make out a dark object decending very slowly towards the mountain. The other two lights just went away. It was very dark by then but the image of the dark object decending very slowly caught my attention. I have lived here all my life and have never seen anything like this before and I am a skeptic.

location: Beacon Rock State Park, WA, USA

description:

At approximately 9pm we were walking west on the camp road to catch the trail to the restroom. I noticed some unusual orange glowing lights overhead and to our right which I pointed out to my friends. The lights were tracking way above and slightly to the right of a power line cut through forested land. There was no sound. The initial lights I saw were clustered in a small group. I didn’t count them but there were about 5 with a couple other ones trailing behind. They were not symmetrically spaced. I observed about 18-20 of these orange glowing lights in a period of about 20 minutes. After the initial cluster of lights, the ones that followed were singular and more spaced out.
As my friends and I marveled at the lights, I recalled that my binoculars were in the car and ran back to get them. I also called another woman over from another campsite to observe the lights. Through my binoculars I could see that the lights were perfectly round. They were not solid colored orange but appeared to have grey shadows…

location: Beacon Rock State Park, WA, USA
summary: Orange spheres moving across the night sky that look like fire.
description:
We were camping at Beacon Rock State Park in the Washington Columbia Gorge when we saw fireball appearing spheres moving across the sky at about the level that a small plane would fly.
Initially there were five of the fireballs in a formation. I believe there were a row of three and then a row of two. After that there were about a dozen more orange spheres in single file spaced far apart moving west to east. We kept thinking that the display was over and then another fireball would pop into view from the western sky. They were quite bright and moving faster than a small plane would. They were gaining elevation at a low angle. They would eventually disappear. It is unclear whether they entered the cloudbank and were just no longer visible or perhaps burned out.

summary: Mysterious light source traveling in many directions, then randomly disappears, but is still able to see an object wandering in the sky
description:
I have seen a circular like object wandering in the sky.
I first assumed it was an airplane, but instead of a blinking light, this object had a constant light source. 
Also, unlike an airplane this object did not have a constant travel path. It went in many directions. 
Then, after approximately 3 minutes, the light source mysteriously disappeared. Even though the light disappeared, I was still able to see the minuscule black object moving around in the distance. 
After 5 minutes I lost sight of the object. I am 100% positive this u.f.o was not a shooting star or an airplane.

Much faster than any plane that I have ever seen in the sky. 
We had binoculars and were able to look at them closer and they were spherical in nature, but their shape also would morph every once in awhile. I would describe it as a brain like shape that had a glowing nature to it like a campfire. They glowed orange (from dark orange to lighter orange at the top) and pulsated like a beating heart. Much like a glowing Chinese lantern, that floated effortlessly through the sky.

summary: Large grayish rectangle outlined in the sky
description:
I was driving with my wife mid-afternoon on June 2, 2012, eastbound on I-90 Kennedy Expressway in Chicago. I had passed O'Hare a couple miles back, when I noticed a rectangle in the NE sky similar to a drive-in movie screen. 
At first I thought it was a new billboard and then I realized it was way far in the distance and very high in the sky, about 45 to 50 degrees above horizontal. There was no visible support for the rectangle and the sky out over Lake Michigan was only slightly hazy. 
I was about to point it out to my wife when traffic and buildings obscured my view for a quarter mile or so, and I was never able to catch sight of it again.
I am a pilot and post this as a matter of interest. I realize there is at least one possible explanation, that of an aircraft towing a banner. Although this did not appear to be what I saw.

summary: 6/2/12 Willow Springs IL, Flashing bright white little circle lights formed a circle shape

Sometimes they would change color. Then at 3:00 AM they just disappeared.

summary: Glowing bright red light observed suspended above pasture in Graham, Washington, June 1, 2012.
description:
A glowing red object was observed from the second story of my house at 11:24pm the night of June 1, 2012. A single, large red light was seen over the neighbor's horse pasture and community pond. The object was silent and enveloped in a swirl of thin fog. The red light shone steadily and did not fade, wink out, or move. Because of the thin fog swirling around, the rays of light coming out of the red object was reminiscent of old illustrations of illumined beings stepping out of the sky.
I had just been looking out another window on the same side of the house, finished in that room and walked down the hall, past two other rooms to check on the window in the small bedroom. That's when I saw it. In the no more than 12 seconds it took for me to walk from one bedroom to the next and open the drapes, it appeared.
The object remained in a stationary position, suspended at about 200 feet in the air.
I watched it for about a minute. As I watched this strange red object, I started to feel as though I was being hypnotized. I felt a panic begin to envelop me, a growing fear of what it might do. This is what really surprised me more than anything during this whole event, the fear of some…

summary: Missing time - I can't account for how I got from my truck into a neighborhood 30 minutes away.
description:
I'd like to report missing time. It happened 10 years ago but I didn't know what it was when it happened. I'll keep it short I was driving my friend home on a lone country road late at night (I'd say 10pm-12am) in Southern Az next to the Mexican border. I usually drive into the neighborhood and drive him right up to his house but this time I parked outside the neighborhood on the lone country road. I remember him getting out of the truck and walking across the park to his house. Single cab Dodge ram. Nobody on the road and fields all around.
Next thing I know I'm walking in the middle of his neighborhood disoriented and scared out of my mind. Visibily shaken, I remember Calling out to a car that drove by. I was walking and had nothing in my pockets and I was 25 minutes walk at least from my truck. Crying the entire walk back to where I HOPED my truck was. I remember being scared the most.. I had no idea how I got there! I got back to my truck and the door was open, truck still on I think. Lights in cab were on, I'm not sure about headlights. I pushed it out of my mind and tried to chalk it up to..... Idk.... I honest to God have never had that happen before or since. I remember it…

Another 50 or so must have gone by, one following another in a slanted but straight line, as if afixed to a wing, but I could see stars through them so they must not have been attached to anything. My friends and I had the eerie feeling that they were observing us observing them. My friends neighbor, an elderly lady came home and she observed the lights as well, he then went in his house to call out his sister who also came out and observed the lights. The lights went across the sky from North to South, once the lights reached the end of the horizon they seemed to "blink out". Once one blinked out, another would appear on the north side horizon. After about 20 minutes of this the last light appeared and followed the…

summary: 9-10 Orange bright lighted objects hovering in a three near perfect perpendicular columns.
description:
We were driving east on County Road 11 from Pequot Lakes to Breezy Point when I noticed 9-10 bright orange lights in the sky flying in three almost perfect perpendicular columns off in the distance maybe 1-2 miles out. 
I slowed down the car to take in the scene and my other two passengers in the car witnessed them too. They appeared to be hovering over Pelican Lake. We watched them for about 4-5 minutes before they slowly faded away individually, one light at a time.

summary: An iridescent orange, cylinder shaped object spotted in St. Paul, MN
description: On June 1, 2012 at approximately 10:05pm I was traveling on Cheuneman Street. I stopped at a stop sign at the intersection of Cheuneman Street and Hoffman Street. I looked up into the sky and noticed something bright. The width was the size of a large school bus and the length was twice the size of that. It was a cylinder shaped object with a bright iridescent orange color. It was similar to the color of the orange hand that instructs pedestrians to stop at a crosswalk. There appeared to be no windows or anything attached to this object. There were flames coming from the bottom of this object blowing towards the SE direction the same length as the object, but it did not make any noise. It was approximately six or seven stories high from the ground. It remained in an upright position and sat in this location for ten seconds before traveling upward towards the East somewhat slowly, about the speed of an airplane in the sky. I watched the orange colored ob! ject travel behind a cloud until it appeared to be grape in size and soon after disappeared. I called the national weather service and I was informed that the wind was blowing 2 miles per hour in the SE direction on that day.

summary: Strange flying objects in the sky
description:
I walked outside to go to the store and looked up into the night sky as I always do when I go outside at night. I saw all of those lights, approximately 4 in the lead in a line followed by a V formation of approximately 8 lights, followed by another v formation of lights, same amount, followed by a trail of lights in a staggered line of about 4 lights. 
They all moved at the same pace, far too close to each other to be planes under the control of the Federal aviation center, but they looked like lights on a plane- the color in the center of the lights were red surrounded by orange and the outer portion yellow. description:

The altitude is not known, but the event lasted some 10 minutes. My wife was able to video record most of the incident. 
Others stopped to view the happening, which actually led to a multiple vehicle accident. The objects where absolutely silent and sequentially disappeared at a certain point in the sky when they finally reached it. 
Was NOT and airplane or helicopter! Seemed to be far to high to be chinese lanterns.
Report from STL policeman. PD

The sighting first started with one object that was pointed out by my neighbor. It looked like a helicopter that had 3 different lights blinking on the back, middle, and front, all blinking randomly. We had thought it might have been a helicopter on fire. It had a somewhat long oval shape and it made no sound.
While we were observing the first object, my girlfriend, neighbor, and his mother accompanied me to the middle of the street to get a better view (because there was tree obstruction). Once we got to the middle of the street we saw another set of objects (3) moving from left to right at the same speed and keeping the same distance from each other. These objects however did not seem to be as close to us as the first object.
At this time the rest of the neighbors came out, and more objects kept coming into view. I wasn't sure if they were suddenly appearing or have been traveling for some time as the treeline was still obscuring some of the view. The objects all had a white with orange tint to them. They still seemed…

summary: saw a glowing orange light traveling at constant speed and altitude no nav lights no sound
description:
Heard you guys describe something I saw a couple month ago on coast to coast tonight. I was standing with my mother talking outside by my car before I left their house and my mother said what do you think that is. I looked up and saw a glowing orange circle traveling at a constant speed and making absolutely no sound whatsoever. Now just so you know I am an aircraft mechanic and I work at Tulsa International Airport so I'm used to seeing planes in the air. This object had no navigational lights and was flying at approximatly 2000 ft and was close enough to us that if it was an airplane we would have heard it, my parents live pretty much right under where the planes line up to land at Tulsa International when there is a prevailing south wind I checked at work the next day and the planes had been coming in from the north the night before because of a prevailing nothern wind so no planes should have been in the area. I have worked on planes for 10 yrs and! have never seen anything remotely like this. The object continued to fly north at constant speed and altitude until it was out of sight.
Witness indicates that the date of the sighting is approximate. PD

summary: Dark gray object that changed shape and “flew” off into the sky until it disappeared
description: When driving northbound on Flat River Road, myself and my passenger at the time witnessed a dark gray object shaped like a cloud that was drawn by a child, hovering over the tree-line in the direction of a recycling center called “Scrap’n”. It was dark gray in color and had low luster (no sunlight reflecting off the surface). The bottom of the object was completely flat and it had three humps on top, with the middle hump being larger than the humps on either side of it (reference the hand drawn illustration, number 1). I observed this shape and questioned why it looked out of place, due to it being a clear sky that day. After a few seconds, the object transformed or shrank into a diamond shape (diamond shape from a deck of cards) with smooth corners. It was also smaller in size once it changed into this shape (reference hand drawn illustration, number 2). After the transition, the object “flew” off or shrank into the sky in an arc formation (reference hand drawn illustration, number 3). It only took a couple of seconds for the object to vanish. The overall experience only lasted around 10 seconds as well.

summary: Saw a Silver, Triangle shaped craft above my car, that sparkled from the rear and then disappeared.
description:
Heading West on Hwy 37, appx. 10 miles due East of Hibbing, a silver, multi-sided triangle (like a spire) appeared above my vehicle and was visible through the top edge of the windshield, around a mile high. It looked to be about the size of a large fighter jet. Clean, complete edging on the craft - No wings, tail, or any such things. 
Suddenly, a blue and red sparkle came out of the rear, and the craft disappeared in a flash, also heading West. My first thought was nothing mankind has created could travel this rapidly, as I had a full and unobstructed view of the horizon. My second thought was that since it was gone in an instant, perhaps it entered another dimension.

I’ve been searching for a plausible answer as to what it was but there is none.

I would estimate it was at a high altitude much like a commercial airliner. There was no noticeable wing span visually or when I zoomed in with my phone camera.  When I noticed the object it was slightly above the tree line of my viewable horizon. I quickly took a picture of the object with my phone. The object was moving in a straight line but very rapidly and was hard to follow with my camera. I had only enough time to take a second picture before it was beyond my view on the opposite horizon. There was no sound or jet trail behind the object.  I have viewed many high altitude planes in my life but have never seem anything like this or moving that rapidly.  The pictures I took were with my IPhone 4s with an 8megapixel camera zoomed in as close as I could get.

summary: UFO Over Lebanon, MO
description:
http://www.youtube.com/watch?v=-qIvLlspMSY

I immediately discounted it as a plane since it was flashing, but then as it got closer I noticed it had 3 lights and then as it got even closer it actually had 4 lights.

Appears to be some sort of craft that may be mimicking an airplane since it has flashing lights. You can clearly see 4 bright lights (maybe engines) that are connected by some sort of dense frame structure. 
Also appears to connect through the middle of the craft from the front light to the back light.
After altering the contrast etc I was able to determined from the video that the tail light flashes, then the left light followed by the nose light. It does not appear that the right light flashes at all.
Once it passed over me the goggles became too saturated with the light and washed out the object and prevented me from getting a sharp image.

I am a 55 year old male who always looks up to watch the sky and this is the first time I am able to say, I am amazed at what I saw and no reasonable explanation can do.

It had all kinds of venting/pipes of some sort on the back end with longer ones towards the outer edges. It was huge-maybe 3-4 times the size of my home. It must have been only 600-700 feet above ground, and seemed to be barely clearing the homes.
I screamed at my neighbors who were outside gardening to look up at the sky. They turned to look where I was pointing to, and shook their heads as if they saw it, but they didn’t seem to get very excited about it.
Later I asked around town if anyone else had seen the craft, but no one had and there were no reports of it on the news. It's very frustrating for me that no one seems to believe me.

It seemed to be moving in one steady direction but could possibly have been gaining altitude at the same time. It simply pulsated a bright red light and was somewhat inconsistent with the pattern in which it pulsated. It would also blink out at random then reappear. It finally blinked out for good and seemed to disappear when it was directly above me and probably directly over the Exton Square Mall.
